title: Outbound Sales Development Manager (SDR Manager) – U.S. B2B Security Services
description:
Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Pacific Business Hours

Compensation: $7-$10/hr USD/hour + Monthly Performance Bonuses

Position: Long-Term, Full-Time Remote



We are a growing California-based private security company providing security guard services, mobile vehicle patrols, security towers, temporary security and other security solutions to commercial clients throughout California.



We are looking for an experienced *Outbound Sales Development Manager / SDR Manager* to build, manage and continuously improve our outbound sales development team.



This is not an administrative sales-manager position.



You will be responsible for building a high-performance outbound sales operation that generates qualified appointments and recurring sales opportunities for our senior security consultants.



What You Will Own



You will be responsible for:



* Recruiting and screening SDRs / outbound sales representatives

* Interviewing and selecting strong cold-calling talent

* Onboarding and training new SDRs

* Conducting daily sales huddles

* Monitoring SDR activity and conversion KPIs

* Reviewing recorded sales calls

* Scoring calls and providing coaching

* Improving cold-call scripts and objection handling

* Maintaining sales pipelines inside GoHighLevel

* Ensuring accurate CRM notes, opportunity stages and follow-up tasks

* Building and maintaining lead-generation processes

* Researching target companies using Google, business directories, company websites and other sources

* Training SDRs to identify and research prospects

* Developing prospecting campaigns by industry and geographic territory

* Monitoring appointment quality and show rates

* Working with our Senior Security Consultants to improve lead quality

* Maintaining weekly, monthly and quarterly pipeline reports

* Identifying underperforming SDRs and creating improvement plans

* Recruiting replacements when necessary

* Building a repeatable outbound sales operation capable of scaling



Industries We Target



Our security services are sold across numerous industries, including:



* Property Management

* Multifamily / Apartments

* HOAs

* Warehousing and Logistics

* Construction

* Shopping Centers

* Retail

* Hotels and Hospitality

* Healthcare

* Manufacturing

* Automotive Dealerships

* Schools and Educational Facilities

* Commercial Real Estate

* Industrial Facilities

* Utilities and Infrastructure

* Vacant Properties

* Events

* Government and Public Agencies



Because we target many industries, the ability to rapidly research new markets and develop prospecting strategies is extremely important.



Our Sales Process



Our SDRs primarily contact businesses through outbound cold calling and follow-up.



The SDR's responsibility is to identify the appropriate decision maker, understand the prospect's potential security needs, qualify the opportunity and schedule a meeting with one of our Senior Security Consultants.



The Senior Security Consultant conducts the detailed discovery call, determines scope, prepares the security proposal and works toward closing the account.



We primarily target recurring contracts for security guards, mobile patrols and security towers, while also pursuing temporary security assignments and RFP opportunities.



Systems



Our primary CRM is *GoHighLevel*.



You must be comfortable managing:



* Contacts

* Opportunities

* Sales pipelines

* Tasks

* Tags

* Custom fields

* Call activity

* Follow-up workflows

* Sales reporting

* Agent performance



Prior GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* 3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience

* Previous experience managing SDRs, appointment setters or cold callers

* Experience selling to U.S. businesses

* Strong spoken English

* Strong written English

* Experience recruiting sales representatives

* Experience conducting call QA and coaching

* Experience creating scripts and objection-handling frameworks

* Strong CRM discipline

* Experience managing sales KPIs

* Strong prospect-research skills

* Experience building outbound pipelines from scratch

* Strong leadership and accountability skills



BPO, call-center management, outsourced sales management, security services, property-management sales or other B2B service experience is highly desirable.



How Performance Will Be Measured



We measure performance using real business outcomes, including:



* SDR productivity

* Qualified conversations

* Qualified appointments held

* Appointment show rates

* Qualified opportunities created

* Pipeline generated

* Security guard hours generated

* Monthly recurring revenue generated

* Proposal opportunities

* Closed accounts

* Call quality

* CRM accuracy

* SDR improvement

* Recruiting and retention



Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience managing outbound sales teams.

3. The largest number of SDRs or sales representatives you have directly managed.

4. The industries you have sold into.

5. The CRMs you have used.

6. Your experience with GoHighLevel.

7. Your experience recruiting sales representatives.

8. Your typical daily outbound-call expectations for an SDR.

9. The KPIs you believe an outbound SDR team should be measured on.

10. A brief explanation of how you would coach an SDR who is making enough calls but not booking qualified appointments.



Applicants who successfully complete the initial interview process may be asked to complete a *paid practical sales-management assessment* involving prospect research, call review, coaching and CRM/pipeline strategy.



We are looking for a manager who can build a department—not someone who simply monitors one.

title: Elite Sales Closer for a Luxury Australian home installation Company
description:
We are a home service business operating in Australia. Our clients are high net worth homeowners, interior designers, architects and premium brands. They expect a polished, confident and warm experience from the very first call.



We’re looking for one exceptional person to become the voice of our business.



What you’ll do



Answer inbound enquiries and call every new lead within minutes

Make outbound follow up calls to warm leads and past clients

Understand each client’s project, recommend the right solution and close the booking on the call

Handle objections with confidence and charm, never pressure

Keep our GHL CRM updated so no lead is ever forgotten

Coordinate bookings with our installation team



Who you are



Your English is absolutely fluent, with a clear, neutral or international accent. Australian, American or British clients should feel like they’re speaking with a local.

You have proven experience closing sales over the phone, ideally with premium, luxury or high ticket clients

You genuinely love talking to people and you thrive on hitting targets

You’re organised, follow up relentlessly and take ownership of every lead

Experience with GoHighLevel, Tradify, or a similar CRM is a big plus

You have a quiet workspace, a quality headset and reliable fast internet with a backup plan



Our standard



Our leads are warm and our service is premium. We expect our closer to convert 80% of qualified enquiries into booked jobs. If that excites you rather than scares you, keep reading.



Hours



Full time, Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Sydney time (currently 5am to 2pm Manila time).



Pay



salary per month is starting at $1200 AUD per month, plus a commission on every job you book. Top performers will be rewarded generously and grow with us.



How to apply (please read carefully)



We do not want your resume. Instead, send a video of 2 minutes or less that includes:



Who you are and your sales experience

Why you’d be excellent at speaking with wealthy, discerning clients

Your best sales win and how you closed it

don't overthink it just be natural 



Start your video by saying the words “I close, I don’t chase.” Make the subject line of your application “Closer professional”. Applications without a video, or without the phrase and subject line, will not be considered.



We will only contact shortlisted candidates. If you’re the best of the best, we can’t wait to hear from you.

• Strong written communication skills and a professional approach to client-related work

We sometimes ask for flexible support on related tasks, but nothing outside your skill set and always with clear communication.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
We’re looking for a reliable and organized Real Estate Administrative VA to support day-to-day operations for a growing real estate business. • Prepare and organize real estate offers, forms, and transaction paperwork

title: Customer Success Operations Lead (Churn and Refund Risk Management) — $2,500 USD p/m + Bonuses
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Leadership Role



Salary: Start at $2,000 per month during the first 2-month trial period.

After successful completion, move to $2,500 per month plus performance-based bonuses.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is not a short-term job.

We build long-term leadership inside the company.



You will work directly with the leadership team to improve performance, systems, and retention across our Customer Success department.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time stable income

- Monday to Friday schedule: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours per week.

- Flexible working hours

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear salary progression after trial

- Real ownership and leadership responsibility

- Direct collaboration with senior leadership

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- High-growth environment

- Strong company culture



TASKS



Refund & Payment Investigations

- Look into all refund requests, chargebacks, canceled plans, and failed payments.

- Check sales call recordings, chat logs, and account notes to gather the facts.

- Find out the real reason for the issue (bad sales promises, poor delivery, or client personal issues).

- Show leadership clear evidence before any money is refunded.



Stopping Client Loss Early

- Spot unhappy or inactive clients in chat groups before they ask for refunds.

- Answer and manage urgent refund or dispute threads on the same day.

- Turn common client issues into clear step-by-step guides (SOPs) so team members avoid making the same mistakes.



Tracking & Reporting

- Keep live dashboards updated with lost money, refund rates, and risk trends.

- Send weekly reports to leadership showing main refund reasons and team gaps.

- Keep client data clean and accurate in Airtable.



You own outcomes here. We expect you to take charge, solve problems, and keep systems running smoothly.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years experience in CS operations, financial risk, refunds, or QA (coaching, online courses, or software background preferred).

- Proven history investigating refunds, finding root causes, and lowering chargebacks.

- Strong skills in Google Sheets, Airtable, CRMs, and performance dashboards.

- Able to audit sales calls and chat histories to write clear case notes.

- Great written and spoken English.

- Able to work independently across different time zones.



OPTIONAL BUT PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- checking sales call quality

- payment systems and merchant payment plans.

- past work inside high-ticket coaching companies.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Outbound Sales & Lead Generation
description:
Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Outbound Sales & Lead Generation



Remote | Part-Time to Start | U.S. Eastern Time (EST)



Are you an experienced Cold Caller, Telemarketer, or Appointment Setter with strong English communication skills and the confidence to speak with prospects over the phone?



We are looking for a results-driven Cold Caller / Outbound Sales Virtual Assistant to contact prospective customers, generate leads, handle objections, and schedule qualified appointments. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in cold calling, outbound telemarketing, lead generation, and appointment setting, and can maintain a professional, confident tone even when facing rejection.



This role is ideal for someone who is resilient, persuasive, proactive, and comfortable working toward daily call targets and appointment-setting goals.



What You'll Do

- Outbound Cold Calling: Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers using provided lead lists, scripts, and calling guidelines.

- Lead Generation & Prospecting: Engage potential customers, identify opportunities, and generate qualified leads through phone outreach.

- Appointment Setting: Schedule qualified appointments, discovery calls, or sales meetings with interested prospects.

- Lead Qualification: Ask strategic questions to understand prospect needs, assess fit, and determine appropriate next steps.

- Objection Handling: Respond professionally to objections, navigate rejection, and keep conversations productive without being pushy.

- CRM & Call Tracking: Record call outcomes, prospect details, notes, follow-up dates, and booked appointments accurately in the CRM.

- Follow-Up & Pipeline Management: Reconnect with warm leads, follow up with interested prospects, and maintain consistent outreach.

- Performance Tracking: Meet agreed-upon targets for call volume, lead generation, follow-ups, and qualified appointments.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Cold Calling Experience: At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience in cold calling, outbound sales, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting.

- Strong Spoken English: Clear pronunciation, professional verbal communication, and the ability to hold natural conversations with U.S.-based prospects.

- Objection Handling: Confidently respond to common sales objections, handle rejection, and think on your feet during calls.

- Appointment-Setting Skills: Able to engage prospects, qualify leads, and guide conversations toward a clear next step.

- Sales Resilience: Comfortable making repeated outbound calls, hearing “no,” and maintaining a positive, professional attitude.

- CRM & Dialer Knowledge: Familiarity with calling software, multi-line dialers, lead trackers, and CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

- Organization & Follow-Through: Able to maintain accurate call records, complete follow-ups, and manage leads consistently.

- Remote Work Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a dedicated quiet workspace, and a quality USB headset.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a Cold Caller, Appointment Setter, Telemarketer, Sales Development Representative (SDR), or Outbound Sales Representative.

- Experience calling U.S.-based prospects or business owners.

- Familiarity with cold-calling scripts, sales frameworks, lead qualification, and appointment-setting techniques.

- Experience working with daily call targets, sales KPIs, and performance-based goals.

- Ability to follow a script while keeping conversations natural and adapting to different prospect responses.



Schedule & Compensation

- Timezone: U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

- Employment Type: Part-time to start, with potential for additional hours based on business needs and performance.

- Pay: $3.00 per hour



How to Apply



If you have proven cold-calling experience and can confidently communicate with prospects over the phone, we'd like to hear from you.



Apply here: 



Please highlight your cold-calling experience, the types of prospects you've contacted, the tools you've used, and any relevant appointment-setting results in your application.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
About the Role

This is not a traditional content writing position. We are looking for someone who understands direct response marketing, consumer psychology, and the art of selling through words.



You will be responsible for developing compelling copy for
 marketing campaigns, landing pages, sales funnels, and other customer-facing marketing initiatives.



Beyond writing, you will play an active role in creative ideation, developing marketing angles, identifying customer pain points, and testing new messaging strategies that drive conversions.



The ideal candidate is both a strong writer and a creative thinker who can independently research products, identify opportunities, and develop persuasive marketing concepts.



Key Responsibilities



Copywriting & Content Development

Write compelling, conversion-focused copy for
 campaigns, landing pages, product pages, and sales funnels.

Develop persuasive headlines, hooks, calls to action, and promotional messaging designed to drive customer engagement and sales.

Create engaging
 sequences for product launches, promotional campaigns, customer retention, and abandoned cart recovery.

Translate complex supplement ingredients, product benefits, and scientific information into clear, compelling consumer messaging.

Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting messaging to different customer audiences and marketing channels.

Creative Ideation & Marketing Angles

Research customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying motivations to develop fresh marketing angles.

Brainstorm and pitch creative concepts, unique selling propositions, hooks, and campaign ideas.



Analyze competitor messaging, market trends, customer reviews, and consumer behavior to identify new opportunities.

Collaborate with the performance marketing and creative teams to develop and test new concepts.

Identify opportunities to reposition existing products through new messaging, storytelling, and value propositions.

Performance & Optimization

Develop copy variations for A/B testing across
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Use performance metrics such as conversion rates, click-through rates, revenue per recipient, and average order value to improve messaging.

Collaborate with marketing teams to identify underperforming content and develop stronger alternatives.

Continuously refine copy based on campaign performance, customer feedback, and business objectives.

Ensure all supplement marketing claims align with brand guidelines and applicable advertising regulations.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience in direct response copywriting, preferably within DTC, eCommerce, supplements, health, wellness, or beauty.

Proven experience writing high-converting
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Strong understanding of consumer psychology, persuasion, storytelling, and conversion rate optimization.

Ability to independently develop creative marketing angles and campaign concepts.

Experience researching target audiences, competitors, and customer pain points.

Ability to interpret marketing performance data and use insights to improve copy.

Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.



Familiarity with FTC/FDA supplement advertising guidelines is a plus.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who does more than execute a writing brief. We want a creative problem-solver who can bring new ideas to the table.

Someone who can look at a product, understand the customer, identify what makes it compelling, and develop messaging that makes people want to buy.



You should be comfortable testing unconventional angles, challenging existing messaging, and continuously looking for ways to improve marketing performance.

title: Content & Marketing Assistant – YouTube, Instagram, Shorts (Part-time, grows to Full-time)
description:
Schedule: Flexible, with 2–3 hours overlap with Brisbane time (AEST, UTC+10)



About us

I'm Enoch, founder of a growing couch restoration and resale business in Brisbane, Australia. We buy second-hand couches, restore them and resell them, and we're documenting the whole journey on YouTube and Instagram: the flips, the business behind them, and the sales lessons along the way. I'm building a small content team to work alongside me, and this is the first key hire.



The role

You'll be my content partner, my other brain on the channel. You'll help d
 what we film, shape it with our video editor and designer, get it posted, and dig into the numbers with me to work out what to make next. I bring the face and the story; you help turn it into a consistent, growing channel.



What you'll do



Plan a weekly content calendar: 1 long-form YouTube video, plus Shorts, Reels and posts cut from it

Research topics, trending hooks and what similar creators are doing

Write 3–5 hook options and a bullet-point outline for each video, then review my rough ideas for strong hooks and structure

Brief the video editor, check edits against the outline, and give clear feedback

Brief our designer on ad creatives and thumbnails: which hooks and angles to test, and what the results say

Make quick Instagram posts and Stories from our Canva templates

Write captions, titles and descriptions; schedule and post on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok

Reply to comments and DMs in our voice

Later: build ManyChat flows to collect leads, and write a weekly
 newsletter from the week's content

Track the numbers (views, watch time, followers, leads) and run a 30-minute weekly review with me to d
 what we make next

You'll suit this if you



Have 1+ years managing social media or content for a creator or small business (show me the accounts)

Can make simple graphics in Canva from templates

Understand hooks, retention and why some short videos go viral and others don't

Write natural, casual English

Are organised and reliable: you hit deadlines without reminders

Are comfortable with Notion or Google Sheets, Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio

Bonus: experience in Meta Ads Manager (setting up campaigns, reading CTR and cost per lead), ManyChat,
 tools (Kit, Beehiiv or similar), basic CapCut editing

To apply



Send links to 2–3 accounts you've managed, with your results

Tell me about one piece of content you planned that performed well, and why you think it worked

Watch any short couch-flipping or furniture-restoration video on YouTube and write 3 hooks you'd use for a similar video

Start your application with the word "Couch" so I know you read this far

title: Creative Strategist & Ecom Ad Copywriter
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand looking for a talented Creative Strategist & Copywriter who understands what makes people stop scrolling, pay attention, and buy.



This isn't a typical copywriting job where you simply follow instructions.



You'll have the freedom to research, develop creative angles, and turn customer insights into winning ad concepts. We value great ideas, independent thinking, and measurable results.



-Compensation & Benefits-



$1,000/month guaranteed base salary



- Performance bonuses of up to $600 per winning ad concept

- Potential earnings of $2,000–$3,000/month based on results

- Long-term, stable, full-time opportunity

- Work remotely with a fast-growing e-commerce brand

- Creative freedom and ownership of your work

- Opportunity to grow as the brand scales



-What You'll Be Doing-



You'll be responsible for developing 30 video ad concepts and 10 static ad concepts per month. Your responsibilities include:



- Researching target audiences, competitors, and emerging market trends

- Discovering powerful customer pain points, desires, and buying motivations

- Developing compelling hooks, unique angles, and persuasive ad concepts

- Writing conversion-focused video ad scripts and static ad copy

- Creating easy-to-follow creative briefs for our production team

- Using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing

- Studying ad performance to continuously improve future concepts

- You focus on the strategy and creative ideas. Our production team handles execution.



-Who We're Looking For-



We're looking for someone who:



- Has experience writing or conceptualizing successful e-commerce ads

- Understands direct-response marketing and consumer psychology

- Knows how to craft hooks that grab attention within seconds

- Can research products and uncover fresh advertising angles

- Understands advertising metrics and performance

- Is comfortable using AI tools

- Can work independently without constant supervision

- Communicates clearly in English (B1 or higher)

- Wants a serious, long-term, full time opportunity



We care more about your ability to develop winning ads than impressive job titles or fancy credentials.



-Why Join Us-



We believe great creative strategists should be rewarded when their ideas generate results.



You'll receive a guaranteed monthly salary, have meaningful creative ownership, and earn additional bonuses when your concepts succeed.



If you're someone who enjoys understanding customers, studying winning ads, and figuring out why people buy, you'll feel right at home.



-How to Apply-



Start your application with "I write killer ads." so we know you've read the job description. Then answer these questions:



- What's the highest ad spend achieved by a single ad you've personally conceptualized and written?

- How do you research a product and discover compelling advertising angles?

- What's your process for writing an ad that converts?

- Share examples of your previous ad scripts, creative briefs, or portfolio.

- What's your earliest available start date?



Bonus: Include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and walking us through one of your best ad concepts.



We're reviewing applications immediately and looking to hire ASAP. If you love creating ads that sell, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Property Manager
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy, and proactive Offshore Virtual Assistant to manage the day-to-day operations of our residential property portfolio. You will act as the primary point of contact for tenants, vendors, and owners, ensuring properties are maintained, rent is collected, and administrative tasks are handled efficiently. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable using property management software and can handle conflict resolution with professionalism.



Key Responsibilities:

1.⁠ ⁠Tenant Relations & Communication

- Act as the first point of contact for tenant inquiries via phone,
, and SMS.

- Handle tenant complaints regarding maintenance, noise, or lease violations.

- Coordinate and schedule property showings for prospective tenants.

- Screen potential tenants by conducting initial phone interviews and verifying references.

- Send reminders for rent due dates and follow up on late payments professionally.



2.⁠ ⁠Maintenance Coordination

- Receive and triage maintenance requests from tenants.

- Dispatch work orders to appropriate vendors/contractors.

- Follow up with vendors to ensure work is completed timely and within budget.

- Obtain quotes for major repairs and present them to the Property Owner for approval.

- Maintain a database of preferred vendors (plumbers, electricians, handymen).



3.⁠ ⁠Administrative & Lease Management

- Prepare, send, and track lease agreements and renewals.

- Maintain accurate digital filing systems for leases, inspection reports, and receipts.

- Manage move-in and move-out processes, including coordinating security deposit returns.

- Assist with rent collection and ledger reconciliation using property management software.

- Draft and distribute notices (e.g., rent increases, entry notices, violations).



4.⁠ ⁠Marketing & Leasing

- Create and post property listings on platforms like Zillow, Trulia, or
 Marketplace.

- Coordinate photography and virtual tours for vacant units.

- Manage the application process and run background/credit checks.



Qualifications:

- 2+ years of experience in Property Management, Real Estate Administration, or a similar VA role within the Australian market.

- Software Proficiency: Experience with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, RentManager, Propertyware) is required.

- Tech Stack: Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), Slack, Asana/Trello, and VoIP systems (RingCentral, Google Voice).

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills. Neutral accent is preferred.

- Organization: Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

- Problem Solving: Ability to resolve tenant disputes calmly and effectively.

- Technical Requirements (Home Office)

- Computer: Desktop or Laptop with at least 8GB RAM and i5 processor (or equivalent).

- Internet: Primary connection of at least 20 Mbps download speed; backup connection preferred.

- Audio: Noise-canceling headset with a high-quality microphone.

- Environment: A quiet, professional home office free of background noise.

title: Media Buyer
description:
About JBI

JBI Advertising is a performance marketing agency obsessed with results. We engineer predictable, scalable lead generation for ambitious companies across legal, financial and home-improvement verticals — combining data, testing and bold creative to drive real growth. We're a tight team of strategists, media buyers and video editors who move fast, stay curious, and genuinely care about doing great work.



02 The Role

We're a fast-growing UK pay-per-lead marketing agency focused on high-volume lead generation for clients in the legal claims sector — personal injury, financial claims, US motor vehicle a
 and more. As a Media Buyer, you'll understand the pay-per-lead model at a strategic level, managing campaigns that generate thousands of leads every month while building the internal systems required to support consistency and guidance for junior media buyers.



03 What we're looking for

- You have 3+ years experience managing direct response CPL lead generation in B2C verticals like Personal Injury, Home Improvement or Finance.

- You've proven experience managing profitable lead generation campaigns.

- You have strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

- You've managed campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google and X.

- You understand landing page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation.

- You have experience with tracking tools and integrations such as Google Tag Manager and Zapier.

- You've built systems or processes that improve media buying operations.

- You can manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.



04 - What you'll be doing

- Plan campaign structures, audiences, creatives and funnels to maximise ROI.

- Continuously test audiences, creatives and funnels to improve performance.

- Conduct market and competitor research to inform campaign strategy.

- Produce performance reports with actionable insights using Google Sheets and other reporting tools.

- Write direct response copy and video scripts, and develop static ad creatives to improve performance.

Weekly team check-ins, creative reviews and training sessions keep everyone connected and continuously learning. Calls typically run between 2pm–6pm GMT on Mondays and Wednesdays.

Growth doesn't stop once you're hired. Whether it's learning from the team around you, joining training sessions, taking on new challenges or developing your leadership skills, we'll support you in growing personally and professionally.

Building a strong culture matters to us. From quarterly games days and team lunches to wellness sessions and challenges, we're always looking for new ways to bring the team together and make JBI a great place to work.

title: Multifamily Acquisition Coordinator
description:
BTX HOMES SOLUTIONS

Part-Time Multifamily Acquisition Coordinator



Remote | North Carolina Investment Focus | Initial 90-Day Contract



About BTX Homes Solutions



BTX Homes Solutions is building a multifamily acquisition business focused on purchasing small apartment properties throughout North Carolina. Our strategy emphasizes 10–60 unit properties, owner-direct opportunities, creative financing and long-term cash flow.



We are seeking a dependable, organized acquisition coordinator who can run the daily acquisition workflow with minimal supervision.



Primary objective

Build and manage a consistent pipeline of qualified multifamily acquisition opportunities, with a preferred purchase price of $2,000,000 or less, while identifying sellers open to seller financing and other creative acquisition structures.

Responsibilities



Research North Carolina multifamily markets and identify properties with 10–60 units.



Build owner lists using county tax records, GIS systems, property records, public data and approved real estate databases.



Identify long-term owners, vacant or underperforming properties, estate-related opportunities and potential seller-financing candidates.

Contact owners and brokers by phone,
 and other legally permitted methods.



Maintain consistent follow-up and document every interaction in the CRM.



Request asking prices, rent rolls, trailing 12-month operating statements, occupancy data and information about property condition.



Screen properties using the company buy box and underwriting spreadsheet.



Ask sellers whether they would consider installment payments, seller financing or other flexible sale terms.



Research potential commercial lenders, asset-based lenders and prospective joint-venture capital partners.



Coordinate preliminary property management estimates, inspections and professional due diligence after authorization.



Deliver a weekly acquisition report showing pipeline status, deal economics, financing possibilities and next actions.



Improve written procedures and eventually help recruit and train additional team members.



Required skills

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization and follow-through.

Experience with real estate research, lead generation, acquisitions, property management or commercial real estate.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems,
 and online public records.

Ability to learn basic multifamily underwriting, including gross rent, operating expenses, NOI, debt service and cash flow.

Professional phone manner and respectful negotiation skills.

Ability to work independently and report measurable results.

Performance expectations



During the first 30 days, the coordinator must establish the CRM, build the initial owner database, begin outreach, create follow-up routines and demonstrate accurate property screening.



By day 60, the coordinator should have active owner conversations, financial documents on interested properties and preliminary financing research.



By day 90, the coordinator should have a repeatable acquisition process and a documented pipeline of qualified opportunities.

Initial planning targets include 50–100 new owner records researched per week, 40–60 owner outreach attempts, 40–60 follow-up attempts and approximately 10 properties screened financially. 



Targets will be adjusted to match working hours, list quality and actual results. Qualified opportunities matter more than raw activity.



Compensation and working arrangement

Part-time contractor engagement, initially approximately 10–15 hours per week.



Proposed starting budget: $400–$600 per month for the initial scope, subject to candidate experience, hours and agreed deliverables.



Paid trial with defined milestones before extending the engagement.

Any incentive or success fee must be agreed in writing and reviewed for legal compliance before implementation.

Authority and reporting

The coordinator may conduct approved research, outreach, follow-up and preliminary analysis independently. The coordinator may not sign purchase contracts, commit company funds, incur unapproved expenses, promise investor returns or bind the company to financing or partnership agreements.



The coordinator reports directly to the owner through a concise weekly dashboard and escalates only material decisions requiring approval.



Application instructions



Please provide:

A summary of your real estate acquisition or research experience.

An example of a property lead list or underwriting spreadsheet you have prepared, with confidential information removed.

The tools and public-record systems you have used.

Your proposed weekly availability and monthly compensation.

A short written explanation of how you would find 10–20 unit apartment buildings owned by sellers who may consider financing part of the purchase price.

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time





How to apply:



- Start your message with the words “Organic Growth”, so we know you read this ad.

- Record a Loom video (max 10 minutes) auditing 
. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

- Share one case study with real numbers: what the situation was, what you did, and what happened to traffic and leads and how long it took.

- In 2–3 sentences, explain how you’d earn high-quality links for a finance company without buying them.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.





If you’re a good fit, we’ll setup a Zoom interview to see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: Web and UI Designer
description:
ABOUT illumination



illumination is a fractional Chief Marketing Officer practice founded by Mandy MacPhee. I help leaders in financial services build the marketing foundations their companies need to grow past what instinct and effort alone can carry. Clients include wealth management firms, fintech companies and professional services businesses across North America.

illumination is an AI-forward practice. AI is part of how the work gets produced every day, from imagery and copy through to website builds. Figma designs feed directly into AI build tools, which gets approved designs into production faster. That puts a lot of weight on how your Figma files are structured. The AI builds from exactly what is in the file, so your naming, auto layout and components all show up in the finished site.

The team is small, and you will work directly with me. No account manager or corporate layer sits between you and the work. Clients see your designs first, so quality and consistency carry a lot of weight here.

ABOUT THE ROLE



I am hiring a Web and UI Designer to design client websites and landing pages in Figma. You will take each project from wireframe to final, development-ready design. A developer builds from your files, so this role involves no coding or CMS work.

Website work takes most of your time. The rest goes to graphic design and video for client campaigns, including social media graphics, ad creatives,
 templates, custom imagery, video editing and motion graphics.

Hours range from 15 to 30 per week, depending on the client work in progress. The role is ongoing.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



-Wireframes and User Flow

Before any visual design starts, you will map how a visitor moves through the site. That covers which pages exist, how they link, what each page needs to say and where the contact points sit. Wireframes are low fidelity and carry no branding. I review and approve them before high-fidelity work begins.



-Website and Landing Page Design

You will design full websites, single pages and campaign landing pages. Approved wireframes become high-fidelity designs with final typography, colour, imagery and components. Every design needs desktop and mobile versions. Layouts should move visitors toward one clear action, such as booking a call or submitting a form.



-Clickable Prototypes

You will link Figma pages into prototypes so clients and I can click through a site from start to finish before it goes to development. That includes interactive elements like accordions, tabs and form layouts.



-Design Systems and Components

For each client, you will set up a Figma design system with colour and type styles, spacing rules, buttons, form fields, cards and reusable components. Pages get built from those components. The site stays consistent, and new pages take less time to produce.



-Handoff to Production

Your Figma files go into AI build tools such as Claude and Google AI Studio. A developer finishes and launches the site from there. You will structure every file so both the AI and the developer can read it: named layers and frames, auto layout throughout, components instead of one-off elements, and specs in Dev Mode. You will also export assets, note interactions and responsive behaviour, answer questions during the build, and check the live site against your designs.



-Multi-Brand Design

Each client has its own brand guidelines. You will move between brand systems without mixing visual identities, and every piece you produce follows that client's brand standards.



-Digital Graphic Design

You will produce social media graphics, digital ad creatives in multiple sizes,
 templates and web graphics. There is less of this than website work, but it is steady.



-Video Editing and Motion Design

You will edit video for client campaigns and social media. That means cutting footage from different sources, adding branded titles, captions, overlays and transitions, and exporting final files sized for each channel. You will also design motion graphics, such as animated social posts, short promotional clips and animated elements for websites.



-Custom and AI-Generated Imagery

You will create custom visuals for client sites and campaigns, including composited images and illustrations. For some clients, you will generate images with AI tools such as Gemini and then edit them to production standard. Raw AI output is a starting point. I expect it refined before it goes into a design.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



Required

-At least 3 years of web or UI design experience, with a portfolio that includes live websites built from your designs.

-Have a good command of English language.

-Advanced Figma skills, including auto layout, components and variants, styles and variables, prototyping and Dev Mode handoff.

-Hands-on experience using Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work. You should be comfortable writing detailed prompts, refining output over several rounds, and recognizing when the output needs more work before it can be used.

-Experience creating wireframes and turning them into high-fidelity designs.

-Responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile.

-Enough understanding of how sites get built to design layouts a developer can produce in Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace or GoHighLevel.

-Working knowledge of accessibility basics like colour contrast, readable type sizes and well-labelled forms.

-Video editing and motion design skills, with samples in your portfolio. You can edit footage, add branded titles, captions and transitions, and create animated graphics for social media and the web in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or similar tools.

-Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

-Canva Pro for fast social media production.

-Experience with AI image generation (Gemini, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly or similar), and the editing skill to bring that output to production quality.

-Strong written English. Briefs and status updates are in English, and I expect you to ask questions when a brief is unclear.

A reliable internet connection, a computer that runs Figma, Adobe tools and video editing software without lag, and a distraction-free place to work.



Preferred

-Design experience in financial services, wealth management, fintech or professional services.

-Agency or freelance experience managing several client brands at once.

-Experience with AI tools that build from Figma files, such as Claude through the Figma connector, Google AI Studio or Figma Make.

-An eye for conversion, including page hierarchy, headline placement and how layout affects form completion.

-Experience using Notion for briefs and project tracking.



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following:

-Your resume or CV.

-A portfolio link with at least two website projects. For each one, include the wireframes, the final Figma designs and a link to the live site. Also include at least two video or motion graphics samples.

-A 3 to 5 minute Loom video walking me through one website project from wireframe to launch. Cover the brief, the structure and layout decisions you made, and how the handoff to development went. Include one example of how you use Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in your design process.



Start your application with the word "wireframe" so I know you read the full posting.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a design test. You will receive a brand guideline file and a wireframe, then design one website page in Figma at desktop and mobile sizes, with components set up and the file ready for developer handoff. Your file will be run through an AI build tool, so file structure is part of how the test is scored.



We especially value applicants who follow instructions carefully. See you online!

title: GoHighLevel Website & Sales Funnel Developer | GoDaddy, SEO & AI Optimization

Job Type: Independent Contractor / Project-Based

Proposed Budget: $500–$800 USD (Negotiable)



About Our Project



We are a U.S.-based travel agency launching an exciting new group travel club featuring international adventures, luxury cruises, networking experiences, and social group vacations.



Our mission is simple:



Bring people together to explore the world, build meaningful connections, experience new cultures, and create unforgettable memories.



We are looking for a highly creative, experienced GoHighLevel website developer and funnel specialist who can bring this vision to life.



This is not a basic website project. We need a beautiful, uplifting, engaging, mobile-friendly, and conversion-focused travel experience that motivates visitors to join our community and book their next adventure.



Our Travel Programs



* Century Cruises: Spring and fall group adventures featuring China, Japan, Vietnam, and Yangtze River experiences.

* Entrepreneurs at Sea: Cruises that bring entrepreneurs and professionals together for networking, business growth, and meaningful connections.

* Connect & Socialize: Fun group vacations for solo travelers, couples, and friends to meet new people and build friendships.

* Alaska Group Cruises: Scenic adventures featuring glaciers, wildlife, and unforgettable experiences.

* Future Group Trips: Additional international destinations, hosted adventures, and private group charters.



Website Design & Creative Expectations



Our landing pages must create an emotional connection with visitors.



We want travelers to feel excited, inspired, welcomed, and confident about joining our upcoming group experiences.



The website should include:



* Beautiful destination photography and engaging travel visuals.

* Modern, premium, colorful, and uplifting design elements.

* Exciting headlines and compelling storytelling.

* Clear messaging focused on experiences, friendships, adventure, and memories.

* Visually appealing trip cards and upcoming departure listings.

* Strong calls to action encouraging travelers to explore trips and join our community.

* Positive, inclusive, and welcoming messaging.

* Mobile-first layouts with smooth navigation and fast loading speeds.



We are not simply selling vacations. We are creating experiences that bring people together.



GoDaddy & GoHighLevel Integration



* Connect our GoDaddy domain to GoHighLevel.

* Build the website and sales funnels within our GHL account.

* Configure DNS, SSL, and domain settings.

* Protect existing website,
, and domain services.

* Ensure the website functions correctly across desktop and mobile devices.



Website & Funnel Development



* Build the main group travel homepage.

* Create an upcoming group trips calendar or searchable directory.

* Design individual landing pages for travel programs and departures.

* Add itinerary descriptions, travel dates, prices, inclusions, and images.

* Create booking inquiry forms and waitlists.

* Add travel club membership registration.

* Develop private group and charter inquiry pages.

* Create reusable templates for additional monthly group departures.



GoHighLevel CRM & Automation



* Integrate website inquiry forms directly with GHL.

* Set up separate lead pipelines for each travel program.

* Create automatic
 and SMS follow-ups.

* Configure lead tagging and notifications.

* Track inquiries and booking conversions.

* Ensure all follow-up sequences are tested before launch.



SEO & AI Search Optimization



* Foundational keyword research.

* Technical and on-page SEO optimization.

* Proper headings, metadata, and optimized URLs.

* Relevant schema markup.

* Google Analytics 4 and Search Console integration.

* Mobile performance optimization.

* Best practices for visibility on Google, Bing, ChatGPT Search, and other AI-powered search platforms.



Revisions & Final Approval — Very Important



We are looking for a contractor who values collaboration, creativity, communication, and attention to detail.



The business owner will have final approval over all designs, landing pages, website content, and functionality.



Our expectations include:



* Unlimited reasonable revisions within the originally agreed project scope until final approval.

* Willingness to make design, layout, color, messaging, and functionality adjustments.

* Regular progress updates with working previews.

* No additional charges for correcting errors, broken features, or incomplete agreed deliverables.

* No website launch without written approval from the business owner.

* Timely implementation of requested changes.

* Clear communication throughout the project.

* Any additional features outside the agreed scope must receive approval and a separate quote before work begins.



We want a contractor who takes pride in creating a polished final product rather than rushing to finish a project.



Final Deliverables



1. Fully functional GoHighLevel group travel website.

2. GoDaddy domain integration.

3. Exciting, uplifting homepage and travel program landing pages.

4. Upcoming group travel calendar.

5. Century Cruises itinerary landing pages.

6. Entrepreneurs at Sea landing page.

7. Connect & Socialize landing page.

8. Alaska group cruise landing page.

9. Travel club registration and booking inquiry forms.

10. GoHighLevel CRM pipelines and automated follow-ups.

11. Foundational SEO and AI search optimization.

12. Mobile and desktop testing.

13. Final revisions and business owner approval before launch.

14. Basic documentation for managing the website and future departures.



Requirements



* Proven experience with GoHighLevel website and funnel development.

* Experience with GoDaddy domain connections.

* Strong creative web design skills.

* Knowledge of CRM automation and lead generation.

* Understanding of SEO and AI search optimization.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and accept constructive feedback.

* Strong English communication skills.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Three examples of GoHighLevel websites you personally developed.

2. Examples of engaging, high-converting landing pages.

3. Confirmation of GoDaddy domain integration experience.

4. Your experience with SEO and AI search optimization.

5. Your proposed fixed-price quote and timeline.

6. Confirmation that you accept our revision and final approval requirements.



We are seeking a dedicated independent contractor in the Philippines who shares our passion for creating exceptional travel experiences and building long-term business relationships.

title: Experienced Facebook Group Growth & Community Manager | Travel Industry
description:
Experienced
 Group Growth & Community Manager | Travel Industry



Company: Mikey Adventures Travel by Cruise Planners

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Job Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Experience Level: Advanced / Experienced Professionals Only



About Our Company



We are a U.S.-based travel agency expanding our group travel division and launching a new
 travel community.



We are looking for a highly experienced
 Group Growth & Community Manager with a proven track record of building, growing, and managing successful
 groups.



We are NOT looking for beginners.



We have seen other successful travel advisors build
 communities exceeding 
,000 members. Our objective is to build a community of 10,000+ genuine, active, travel-loving members and eventually grow beyond that milestone.



We need someone who understands organic
 growth strategies, audience engagement, content creation, community management, and lead generation.



Our mission is to bring people together to explore the world, create meaningful friendships, experience incredible destinations, and build unforgettable memories.



Our Group Travel Programs



Our community will feature:



* Century Cruises: International group adventures featuring China, Japan, Vietnam, and Yangtze River cruises, with spring and fall departures.

* Entrepreneurs at Sea: Networking cruises for business owners, entrepreneurs, and professionals.

* Connect & Socialize: Hosted group vacations focused on friendships, social connections, and meeting new people.

* Alaska Cruises: Scenic group departures featuring glaciers, wildlife, and exciting excursions.

* Future Group Vacations: Additional international destinations, luxury cruises, and hosted travel experiences.



Key Responsibilities



1.
 Group Creation & Professional Setup



* Assist with creating and launching a new private
 travel group.

* Design an attractive, professional
 group cover.

* Write a compelling group description, welcome message, and community guidelines.

* Configure membership questions, approval settings, and moderation tools.

* Organize featured posts, travel announcements, and discussion topics.

* Ensure the group reflects our uplifting, exciting, welcoming travel brand.



2. Organic
 Group Growth — Major Priority



* Develop and execute a comprehensive organic
 group growth strategy.

* Attract genuine members interested in international travel, group cruises, and social adventures.

* Focus primarily on potential travelers in the United States.

* Identify opportunities to promote the group through relevant communities, partnerships, referrals, and approved outreach.

* Create a realistic growth roadmap toward 10,000+ genuine members.



STRICTLY PROHIBITED:



* Fake
 accounts.

* Bots or automated fake memberships.

* Purchased members or followers.

* Engagement farms.

* Spam-based invitations or unsolicited mass messaging.

* Artificial engagement or misleading growth reports.



We prioritize authentic growth, qualified members, and meaningful engagement over inflated membership numbers.



3. Content Creation & Daily Posting



The contractor must be creative, proactive, and comfortable creating and publishing original, engaging
 content.



Responsibilities include:

* Develop travel-related graphics, photos, reels, videos, polls, and discussion posts.

* Share exciting destination inspiration and upcoming group adventures.

* Create posts encouraging members to interact, ask questions, and share travel experiences.

* Publish engaging questions, travel challenges, and interactive discussions.

* Promote Century Cruises, Entrepreneurs at Sea, Connect & Socialize, and Alaska group departures.

* Develop content around friendship, travel experiences, networking, adventure, and memorable moments.

* Maintain a consistent brand voice that is positive, uplifting, exciting, and welcoming.

* Prepare a content calendar for business owner review.

* Respond to comments and help encourage meaningful conversations.



We want members to feel genuinely excited about being part of our travel community.



4. Community Engagement & Management



* Welcome new members and encourage introductions.

* Review pending membership requests.

* Respond to relevant comments and questions.

* Encourage discussions among community members.

* Identify engaged members who may be interested in upcoming trips.

* Maintain a welcoming, respectful, and spam-free environment.

* Encourage existing members to invite friends who genuinely enjoy traveling.

* Suggest creative activities to strengthen community relationships.



5. Lead Generation & Website Integration



Our
 group should support the growth of our travel agency.



Responsibilities include:



* Promote our upcoming group departures and travel club website.

* Encourage interested travelers to submit booking inquiries.

* Direct members to the appropriate trip landing pages.

* Coordinate with our GoHighLevel website developer.

* Help track leads generated through
.

* Identify opportunities to convert member interest into group travel bookings.

* Support promotional campaigns for upcoming departures.



Daily Reporting — Mandatory



Daily performance reports are required, not weekly reports.



The contractor must provide a written report every working day covering:



1. Total
 group members.

2. Number of new members added that day.

3. Number of pending membership requests.

4. Number of genuine members approved or declined.

5. Content published that day, including links.

6. Post engagement, comments, and discussions.

7. Membership growth activities completed.

8. Website clicks and qualified travel inquiries, where tracking is available.

9. Challenges, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.

10. Planned activities for the following working day.



We expect accurate, transparent reporting supported by
 Group Insights and other available analytics.



Required Qualifications



* Demonstrated experience successfully growing
 groups.

* Proven track record of attracting genuine, organic members.

* Strong knowledge of
 community growth strategies.

* Experience managing large and active
 groups.

* Advanced content creation and
 marketing skills.

* Experience with Canva, reels, graphics, and engaging social media content.

* Strong community management and moderation skills.

* Understanding of lead generation and conversion strategies.

* Excellent written English.

* Ability to work independently, solve problems, and suggest new ideas.

* Consistent communication and attention to detail.



Experience growing
 groups to 5,000–10,000+ real members is strongly preferred.



Travel and tourism marketing experience is a significant advantage.



Creative Direction, Revisions & Final Approval



The business owner retains final approval over branding, community strategy, major campaigns, and promotional messaging.



The contractor must:



* Be receptive to feedback and reasonable revisions.

* Proactively suggest fresh content and innovative ideas.

* Follow established brand guidelines.

* Submit major campaigns and promotional content for approval before publication.

* Independently create and publish routine daily content within approved guidelines.

* Maintain a professional and collaborative working relationship.



We value creativity, initiative, accountability, and measurable results.



Our Long-Term Growth Objective



Our first major milestone is building a
 community of 
,000+ genuine members.



However, success is not measured by membership numbers alone.



We want a thriving community where members actively communicate, build friendships, share travel experiences, and become interested in joining our group vacations.



The ultimate objective is to create a recognizable travel community that consistently generates qualified travel inquiries and contributes to confirmed group bookings.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Links to
 groups you have personally managed or helped grow.

2. Your experience growing
 groups, including starting and ending membership numbers.

3. Evidence of genuine organic growth, such as
 Group Insights screenshots.

4. Examples of original content you have created.

5. Your strategy for attracting our first 1,000 genuine travel community members.

6. Your proposed strategy for eventually reaching 10,000+ members.

7. Your available working hours and experience targeting U.S. audiences.



Important: Generic applications without evidence of previous
 group growth experience will not be prioritized.



We prefer experienced Filipino independent contractors rather than agencies.



We are looking for an experienced professional who can help us build one of the most engaging group travel communities, attract real members, and turn our travel club into a recognizable and successful brand.

title: Content Creator & Manager

of great clients. You’ll turn ideas into thoughtful, on-brand content and use AI to work efficiently without losing the human touch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

documents, and you make sure tone of voice and positioning stay on point.

you, whether that's AI, Canva or something else

put plans into decks



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

project knowledge to keep content on brand

nothing reads or looks like AI

• Are a strong digital communicator. We'll meet about once a week, and the rest

happens over chat (Slack, WhatsApp or Teams), so you don't need a lot of

meetings to get direction.

and flagging blockers early

HOW WE WORK

We’ll have about one check-in call each week. Day-to-day work happens over chat and Asana. Hours are flexible, as long as the work gets done, but you should be proactive, independent, and a great digital communicator.



HOW TO APPLY

- Samples of your work or portfolio

title: Immediate start Direct Response Video Ads Editor
description:
We're an ecommerce brand scaling our Meta ads, and we need an editor who makes video ads that convert, not just ads that look good.

You'll build ads from B-roll we provide, along with room to bring your own broll/ideas. We're looking for someone who wants a long-term, exclusive role and to grow with the brand.



What you'll do

* Edit direct-response video ads with provided voice overs

* Use performance feedback to make each round of ads better



What we look for in your work

* Relatability: Viewers see themselves in the first 3 seconds through age, environment, lifestyle and frustration. Real homes and real people. know who the ad is selling to and match it visually

* Congruency: B-roll matches the exact line being spoken, especially when explaining the mechanism. No generic filler clips.

* Hook visuals: Visuals and copy line up from frame one. Nothing Meta will flag in the hook. The visual carries the sensitive part of the problem so the copy doesn't have to say it.

* Show, don't tell: The mechanism is demonstrated, not just described. Results are shown in real time with labels like Day 1 and Day 10.

* Proof: Real before/after footage. The product is shown in use, not just held. It's revealed late when the story earns it.

* Authority: A real face, even for 2–3 seconds, to anchor the "we/us" peer voice.

* Text and format: Short hook text that fits on screen. Native-looking UI like comment-reply stickers.

* Pacing: No dead or repetitive footage. Every cut earns the next second.



*Important*: We also want someone who can create Collage video ads using images. 



If you don’t understand the above, do not apply.



Requirements

* Proven experience editing DR ads for ecommerce brands

* Fast turnaround without dropping quality

* Clear communication



How to apply Start your application with: "I create high-converting video ads."



Then include:

We are looking for immidiate start.

title: REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS VA BTX HOMES LLC | Remote – Philippines
description:
REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS VA

BTX HOMES LLC | Remote – Philippines



Position: Real Estate Acquisitions VA

Company: BTX Homes LLC

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Part-Time initially, with opportunity for Full-Time

Starting Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour based on experience

Schedule: Monday–Friday with required U.S. business-hour overlap

Industry: U.S. Real Estate Investing / Wholesaling



ABOUT BTX HOMES



BTX Homes LLC is a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties, distressed houses, land, and development opportunities.



Our Lead Generation Team finds potential properties.



Your job is to turn those leads into conversations with property owners and ultimately contracts.



This is a sales and acquisitions position, not a general VA position.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



You will receive leads generated by our virtual Driving for Dollars team.



You will:



CALL → TEXT → FOLLOW UP → QUALIFY → NEGOTIATE → SUBMIT OFFER → FOLLOW UP → GET CONTRACT



Your goal is to create real seller conversations and signed contracts.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. CALL NEW LEADS



Call every new qualified lead assigned to you.



Your objectives are to:



Reach the property owner

Introduce BTX Homes

Determine whether they are interested in selling

Ask questions about the property

Understand their situation

Determine motivation

Determine timeline

Determine price expectations

Determine property condition

Determine occupancy

Determine whether there are repairs needed

2. TEXT EVERY LEAD



When appropriate, send an SMS after the call.



If the seller doesn't answer:



CALL → VOI
 → TEXT → FOLLOW UP



Do not simply call once and move on.



3. FOLLOW-UP EVERY DAY



This is one of the MOST IMPORTANT parts of the job.



Most sellers will NOT sell after the first conversation.



You must consistently follow up.



Follow-up may include:



Day 1: Call + text



Day 2: Call + text



Day 3: Call



Day 5: Call + text



Day 7: Call



Day 10: Text



Day 14: Call + text



Day 21: Call



Day 30: Call + text



Then continue the appropriate long-term follow-up campaign.



4. NEVER LOSE A LEAD



Every seller must have a clear status in the CRM.



Examples:



New Lead

Attempting Contact

Contacted

Interested

Motivated

Follow-Up

Offer Needed

Offer Sent

Negotiating

Verbal Agreement

Contract Sent

Under Contract

Not Interested

Wrong Number

Do Not Contact



Every conversation must be documented.



5. QUALIFY THE SELLER



When you reach the owner, collect:



PROPERTY

Property address

Property type

Bedrooms

Bathrooms

Approximate square footage

Occupied or vacant

Current tenant situation

Condition

Roof condition

HVAC

Plumbing

Electrical

Kitchen

Bathrooms

Major repairs needed

SELLER

Why are they considering selling?

How long have they owned it?

What is their desired timeline?

Are they currently living there?

Are there other owners?

Is there a mortgage?

Are there liens or other issues they know about?

PRICE



Ask:



"If we were able to purchase the property as-is and make the process easy for you, what price would you be looking for?"



Do NOT immediately give the seller our maximum price.



6. IDENTIFY MOTIVATION



We are looking for sellers with a legitimate reason to sell.



Examples:



Vacant property

Inherited property

Landlord tired of the property

Major repairs

Property needs updating

Relocation

Divorce

Estate

Behind on payments

Long-term ownership

Property is becoming a burden

Wants to sell quickly

Wants to avoid making repairs



Do not pressure sellers.



We want to solve problems and create win-win transactions.



7. SEND QUALIFIED DEALS TO ACQUISITIONS



When a lead becomes serious, update the CRM immediately.



The acquisitions process should have enough information for BTX Homes to determine:



BUY / NEGOTIATE / FOLLOW UP / PASS



8. NEGOTIATE



You will be trained on our acquisition strategy.



Your job is NOT to overpay simply to get a contract.



You must understand:



**ARV / MARKET VALUE



REPAIR COST

HOLDING COST

CLOSING COSTS

ASSIGNMENT/PROFIT MARGIN

= MAXIMUM PURCHASE PRICE**



Offers must stay within BTX Homes' approved buying criteria.



9. DAILY CRM MANAGEMENT



At the end of every workday, the CRM should clearly show:



Who you called

Who answered

Who didn't answer

Who was texted

Who needs follow-up

Seller motivation

Asking price

Offer price

Next follow-up date

Current lead status

Notes from conversation



If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.



DAILY KPI TARGETS



Initial targets:



CALLS



75–125 outbound calls/day



TEXTS



50–100 personalized/approved follow-up texts/day



FOLLOW-UPS



Every lead requiring follow-up must be contacted according to the schedule.



CONVERSATIONS



Target 10+ meaningful seller conversations/day as the pipeline develops.



QUALIFIED LEADS



Target 3–5 qualified seller opportunities/day once the lead pipeline is established.



Quality is more important than blindly hitting numbers.



WHAT MAKES A GREAT ACQUISITIONS VA?



We want someone who is:



CONFIDENT



Comfortable speaking with property owners.



PERSISTENT



Doesn't give up after one unanswered call.



ORGANIZED



Keeps every lead updated.



A GOOD LISTENER



Understands the seller instead of simply reading a script.



SALES-MINDED



Knows how to move a conversation forward.



HONEST



Never misrepresents BTX Homes.



PATIENT



Understands that some deals require weeks or months of follow-up.



EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



Experience with any of the following is a PLUS:



U.S. real estate

Real estate wholesaling

Acquisitions

Cold calling

SMS follow-up

Lead generation

Motivated seller leads

Property management

Sales

PropStream

DealMachine

XLeads

Podio

GoHighLevel

Google Sheets

CRM systems



Real estate experience is preferred but not required for the right salesperson.



TRAINING PROVIDED



You will receive an SOP covering:



How to call leads

Opening the conversation

Seller qualification

Motivation questions

Property questions

Price questions

Handling objections

Follow-up procedures

SMS procedures

CRM procedures

Offer procedures

When to escalate a lead

How to identify HOT leads

How to move a seller toward a contract

HOT LEAD RULE



If a seller says anything similar to:



"I want to sell."



"I'm ready to sell."



"Make me an offer."



"How much can you pay?"



"I need to sell quickly."



"The house is vacant."



"I don't want to deal with the property anymore."



"I'll take $____."



Immediately mark the lead:



🔥 HOT LEAD



Notify the BTX Homes team according to the escalation SOP.



FOLLOW-UP IS EVERYTHING



We do NOT believe:



"They didn't answer, so they're not interested."



A lead that doesn't answer today may answer tomorrow.



A seller who says "not right now" may sell six months from now.



Your job is to build the pipeline and maintain professional follow-up.



PAY



Starting:



$4–$6/hour



based on experience.



High-performing acquisitions VAs may qualify for:



Pay increases

Performance bonuses

Deal bonuses

More hours

Full-time employment

Acquisitions Manager opportunity



Compensation can increase significantly for people who consistently help produce closed transactions.



IMPORTANT



This is a PERFORMANCE POSITION.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with BTX Homes.



You will not be micromanaged.



You will be expected to:



SHOW UP

MAKE THE CALLS

SEND THE TEXTS

FOLLOW UP

UPDATE THE CRM

CREATE SELLER CONVERSATIONS

MOVE DEALS FORWARD



HOW TO APPLY



Answer ALL questions below.



1. SALES EXPERIENCE



Tell us about your previous sales or calling experience.



2. REAL ESTATE



Have you worked in U.S. real estate before?



If yes, explain.



3. COLD CALLING



How many outbound calls have you made per day in a previous position?



4. SELLER CONVERSATION



A homeowner says:



"I'm not interested. Stop calling me."



What would you say?



5. PRICE OBJECTION



A seller says:



"I want $200,000. That's my price."



How would you respond?



6. MOTIVATION



Give us 5 questions you would ask to determine whether a seller is actually motivated.



7. FOLLOW-UP



A seller says:



"Call me next month."



What would you do?



8. CRM



What CRMs have you used?



9. TOOLS



Rate yourself 1–5:



Cold Calling:

Sales:

SMS:

Real Estate:

CRM:

Google Sheets:

Negotiation:



10. VIDEO



Please provide a 1–2 minute video introduction explaining:



Your name

Your experience

Why you want this position

Your sales experience

Why you would be good at acquisitions

11. ATTENTION TEST



At the end of your application write:



BTX HOMES – I FOLLOW UP UNTIL THE DEAL IS DONE



Applications without this phrase may not be considered.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Our goal is to build a professional acquisitions team that consistently produces contracts.



If you perform well, there is an opportunity to grow into:



Acquisitions VA → Senior Acquisitions → Acquisitions Manager



We want people who want to build something long-term with BTX Homes.



BTX HOMES LLC



FIND THE LEAD.

BUILD THE RELATIONSHIP.

CREATE THE DEAL.

The Ad Firm is a top digital marketing agency headquartered in Southern California that serves clients nationwide. We are seeking an AI Content Writer to join our growing content team. description:
About The Ad Firm



Founded in 2009, The Ad Firm was born out of a mission to bring complete transparency, scientific performance, and high profitability to the digital marketing industry. Headquartered in Carlsbad, CA, we specialize in SEO, PPC, social media management, and custom web design for small and medium-sized businesses.



We maintain a 5.0-star employee rating on Glassdoor because of our immense focus on professional growth, training support, and goal-oriented incentives. As we scale into 2026, we are expanding our tech stack. We need a dual-threat engineer who can reliably build and maintain client websites while simultaneously stepping up to help us pioneer and experiment with next-generation, autonomous AI agentic workflows.



Job Summary



We are seeking a versatile Web Developer & AI Automation Engineer to join our team. In this hybrid role, you will wear two hats. First, you will act as a core web developer, building high-performance, SEO-optimized websites, managing integrations, and maintaining clean codebase structures for our clients. Second, you will act as our junior AI specialist—helping us explore, build, and test Agentic AI Workflows that automate digital marketing pipelines (like automated content generation, ad auditing, and reporting loops).



This is the ultimate role for an established developer who wants to break heavily into AI and build hands-on experience with multi-agent systems, frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, and frontier LLMs under the guidance of our strategic roadmap.

- Own the technical foundation of the websites we build

Web Development (Core Role)

Agentic AI Workflows (Junior/Growth Role)
