- Help connect AI agents to practical tools by writing scripts and utilizing web hooks to link LLMs with marketing APIs (Google Ads, Meta Graph API, analytics dashboards).

- Build and test simple evaluation loops, helping prompt engineering and agent behaviors self-correct or flag errors before output generation.

- Run experiments to optimize LLM token usage, latency, and agent reasoning structures for internal agency automation.



What We’re Looking For



Web Development Requirements (Mid-to-Senior)



- 5+ years of web development experience in agency or performance-driven environments

- Deep expertise in PHP (including WordPress core-level development)

- Strong JavaScript experience with modern frameworks and tooling

- Working knowledge of Python (automation, scraping, tooling)

- Proven experience building custom WordPress websites from scratch

- Strong understanding of technical SEO and its impact on architecture and performance

- Ability to diagnose and solve full-stack issues independently



AI & Automation Requirements (Junior / Entry-Level)



- Foundational AI Knowledge: A massive passion for AI agents and basic conceptual understanding of how LLMs process data, handle memory, and leverage external tools.

- Framework Exposure: Foundational exposure to or an eager willingness to learn agentic architectures like LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel (personal projects or bootcamps count!).

- Python Skills: Solid script-writing capabilities in Python to handle data manipulation and API calls.



What Sets You Apart



- You think in systems, not pages

- Experience working on large-scale or SEO-heavy websites

- Experience with schema and structured data implementation

- Exposure to programmatic SEO or dynamic page generation

Strong Advantages

What We Don’t Want

description:

**Company:** Florida Pure Water Services (FLPWS)  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours per week  

**Industry:** Water Filtration, Home Services, Lead Generation



## About Florida Pure Water Services



Florida Pure Water Services provides residential and commercial water filtration, water softeners, reverse osmosis systems, and water treatment services throughout Central Florida.



We are growing our business and looking for a dependable, organized, proactive Virtual Operations & Growth Assistant who can help us find new business opportunities, recruit people, coordinate events, and keep daily operations organized.



This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys making phone calls, researching opportunities, communicating with people, and getting things done without constant supervision.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Event Research & Coordination

- Contact event organizers by phone and
 to ask about vendor spaces, booth fees, availability, and application requirements.

### 4. Lead Generation & Research

- Identify opportunities to promote water filtration services.

- Build contact lists and organize prospect information in spreadsheets or our CRM.

- Help schedule future promotional events, partnership meetings, and lead-generation opportunities.



### 5. Administrative & Operations Support

- Update records and manage tasks in GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Maintain spreadsheets, calendars, contact lists, and follow-up schedules.

- Send
s, make calls, and follow up on outstanding tasks.

- Prepare daily and weekly activity reports.

- Help management stay organized and ensure opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong spoken and written English.

- Comfortable making phone calls to people in the United States.

- Professional, friendly, and confident phone communication.

- Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

- Able to research information online and maintain accurate spreadsheets.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Docs,
, and online calendars.

- Willing to learn GoHighLevel and other business software.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet place to work.

- Able to work independently, follow instructions, and take initiative.

- Available to work a full-time schedule with sufficient overlap with Florida business hours.



## What We Are Looking For



We need someone who takes ownership of their work. We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions all day.



The ideal candidate will:

- Make calls confidently and professionally.

- Find opportunities instead of waiting for them to be provided.

- Follow up consistently with event organizers, applicants, and potential partners.

- Keep accurate records of every conversation and next step.

- Communicate problems early and suggest solutions.

- Focus on results, productivity, and helping the company grow.



Previous experience in virtual assistance, recruiting, appointment setting, business development, event coordination, or lead generation is a plus.



## How Performance Will Be Measured



Performance will be evaluated based on:

- Qualified candidates identified and interviews scheduled.

- Events researched, contacted, and successfully booked.

- Realtors and potential referral partners contacted.

- Partnership meetings and follow-up opportunities generated.

- Accuracy of CRM records and spreadsheets.

- Consistency of follow-up and daily reporting.

- Initiative, reliability, and overall productivity.



## How to Apply



Please submit your application along with a **3–5 minute voice recording** demonstrating your spoken English and professional phone communication.



In the recording, briefly pretend you are calling a realtor to introduce Florida Pure Water Services, then calling an event coordinator to ask about booking a booth at a local festival.

title: Influencer Marketing Execution VA
description:
Eliot Management LLC



Remote | Full-Time | Must be available 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST



About Eliot Management LLC

Eliot Management LLC is an influencer marketing and talent management company that helps brands build meaningful relationships with creators and execute high-impact influencer campaigns. We work across influencer sourcing, paid creator campaigns, talent management, brand partnerships, events, and campaign execution. Our team works closely with brands and creators to manage partnerships from initial outreach through final deliverables and reporting. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Influencer Campaign Execution Virtual Assistant to support our growing team.



About the Role

This role is focused on the execution and coordination side of paid influencer campaigns. Once creators have been sourced and deals are confirmed, you will help ensure every campaign detail is properly communicated, tracked, and completed on time. You will manage campaign trackers, deliverables, timelines, creator communications, client feedback, posting schedules, and campaign reporting. You will serve as a key point of coordination between brands, creators, talent managers, and the internal team. This is not a traditional administrative VA position. We are looking for someone who is extremely organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces at once.



Key Responsibilities



Campaign Management

- Support the execution of paid influencer campaigns from confirmed deal through completion.

- Maintain accurate campaign trackers and status updates.

- Track creator participation, campaign requirements, deadlines, posting dates, and deliverables.

- Ensure all campaign details are accurately documented and communicated.

- Monitor campaign progress and proactively identify potential delays or issues.

- Follow up with creators, talent managers, and internal team members to keep campaigns moving.

- Ensure creators and managers understand campaign requirements, expectations, and deadlines.



Client & Creator Communication

- Act as a communication bridge between client brands and creators/talent managers.

- Relay client communications directly to talent managers and creators, ensuring campaign updates, feedback, revisions, and requirements are communicated clearly and in a timely manner.

- Translate client feedback into clear, actionable next steps for creators and managers.

- Follow up with talent managers and creators to confirm receipt and understanding of campaign updates.

- Communicate creator questions, concerns, and feedback back to the internal team and client when appropriate.

- Ensure changes to campaign direction, deliverables, timelines, or requirements are reflected accurately across all relevant parties.

- Maintain clear records of important campaign communications and decisions.

- Proactively flag miscommunication, conflicting information, or potential campaign issues before they escalate.



Deliverables & Content Tracking

- Track creator deliverables from initial brief through final submission.

- Monitor content deadlines and posting dates.

- Review submissions for completeness against campaign requirements.

- Flag missing, late, incorrect, or incomplete deliverables.

- Follow up with creators and managers when revisions or additional materials are required.

- Maintain organized records of live posts, links, screenshots, and campaign assets.

- Confirm campaign requirements have been fully completed before closing out a creator.

- Ensure final deliverables align with the approved campaign scope and client requirements.



Campaign Reporting & Recaps

- Collect campaign performance information and creator deliverables.

- Track views, engagement, impressions, reach, and other relevant campaign metrics.

- Organize creator content and performance data.

- Assist with campaign recaps and client-facing reports.

- Identify missing metrics or reporting information and follow up as needed.

- Maintain clean and accurate campaign records.



Administrative & Team Support

- Manage campaign-related
 communications and follow-ups.

- Assist with calendars, meetings, and campaign deadlines.

- Maintain Airtable, Google Sheets, and other internal systems.

- Support talent management and brand partnership tasks as needed.

- Handle confidential creator, client, and campaign information with discretion.

- Take on ad-hoc operational tasks and proactively identify workflow improvements.



What We're Looking For



Required

- 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, talent management, social media marketing, project coordination, or a similar role.

- Hands-on experience supporting paid influencer campaigns.

- Experience managing campaign timelines, deliverables, or creator relationships.

- Experience communicating with influencers, talent managers, or agencies.

- Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok creator ecosystems.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent organization and follow-through.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

- Ability to work 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST.



Strongly Preferred

- Experience managing influencer campaign deliverables.

- Experience working with talent managers or influencer agencies.

- Experience communicating client feedback to creators or managers.

- Experience with campaign reporting and performance metrics.

- Experience with Airtable, Google Sheets, Asana, Trello, or similar project-management tools.

- Experience working on U.S. influencer marketing campaigns.

- Experience managing multiple creators simultaneously.



The Ideal Candidate



You are someone who:

- Is extremely organized and naturally keeps track of details.

- Notices what is missing before someone has to ask.

- Doesn't let deadlines or follow-ups fall through the cracks.

- Can manage multiple creators and campaigns simultaneously.

- Is comfortable following up repeatedly and professionally.

- Can communicate client feedback clearly without losing important details.

- Can take a campaign task and see it through to completion.

- Keeps trackers, communications, and campaign information organized.

- Is proactive about identifying potential problems before they become issues.

- Moves quickly while maintaining accuracy.

- Is comfortable working with deadlines, deliverables, client feedback, and campaign details.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in influencer marketing, talent management, campaign operations, or creator partnerships.

title: Amazon Fba product sourcer (Online arbitrage, Wholesale arbitrage)
description:
Looking for an experienced Amazon FBA sourcer to find profitable online 

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.



Hours: 25 hours/week required

Pay: Flat weekly rate (based on experience — mention your rate expectations 

when applying)

Quota: Minimum 5-10 vetted leads per day, logged in our shared Google Sheet

Reporting: Google Sheet must be updated daily — no batching leads to dump 

at the end of the week

Performance: Repeated missed quotas or unreported days will result in a 

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues



What you'll do:

- Reverse source: go through other sellers' storefronts on Amazon to find 

 what they're selling, then locate that same product cheaper from the 

 retailer/website they likely sourced it from

- Vet every lead using Keepa (price history, sales rank history, seller 

 count over time) and SellerAmp (ROI, fees, profitability, eligibility)

- Check BSR (Best Seller Rank) against category requirements to confirm 

 it's a fast enough mover before submitting a lead

- Confirm eligibility/ungating status on each ASIN before adding it to 

 the list — don't submit gated items unless already approved

- Flag any IP complaint risk, hazmat, or restricted brand issues

- Update the shared Google Sheet daily with: product name, buy link, cost, 

 sell price, ROI %, BSR, and eligibility status for every lead found

- OFFER COUNT MUST BE LOW



What you need to already know:

-We are gated on lots of products due to us being a new seller

- SellerAmp (SAS) — pulling ROI/profitability and running eligibility checks

- Keepa — reading price/rank history charts, spotting stable vs. volatile 

 listings

- Reverse sourcing / storefront stalking methodology

- What BSR ranges are actually sourceable per category (not just "low 

 number = good")

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red 

 flags



Access provided:

- Your own restricted Seller Central login (Inventory access only — no 

 orders, payments, or financial data)

- Shared SellerAmp login for research

- Shared Google Sheet for daily lead logging

- You will connect YOUR OWN Seller Central login inside SellerAmp when 

 prompted — do not use any other login



To apply: send 2-3 sample leads with your reasoning (Keepa chart read, 

ROI calc, why you picked it). Shortlisted applicants will hop on a call 

to be interviewed before final hire.

title: Senior Xero Accounts Manager | Construction & Engineering (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines



Hours: 40 hours per week, full time



Salary: Starting at USD $10 per hour, negotiable based on experience



Job overview



We're looking for an exceptional Senior Xero Accounts Manager to take full ownership of the accounts, payroll, financial administration and management reporting for our Australian engineering and construction business.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or data entry position.



We need someone highly experienced, sharp, organised and proactive who understands the numbers, identifies problems early and helps management make better financial decisions.



Our business manages multiple construction and engineering projects simultaneously, with significant costs across labour, materials, subcontractors and suppliers.



You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing cash flow, processing Australian payroll, tracking work in progress (WIP) and providing clear visibility over project profitability.



We're looking for someone who can take responsibility for the accounts without needing constant supervision.



Key responsibilities



1. Xero and general accounting



Take ownership of our Xero accounts and maintain accurate financial records.



Complete bank and credit card reconciliations.



Manage accounts payable and receivable.



Prepare customer invoices and manage progress and milestone billing.



Follow up overdue invoices and actively manage collections.



Check supplier invoices against purchase orders and agreed pricing.



Monitor supplier balances, payment terms and upcoming obligations.



Identify duplicate charges, incorrect invoices and unexplained transactions.



Manage month end reconciliations and reporting.



Prepare GST and BAS information for review and lodgement by our accountant or registered BAS agent.



2. Australian payroll



Manage weekly or fortnightly payroll through Xero.



Process timesheets, employee wages and salary payments.



Understand Australian PAYG withholding, superannuation and Single Touch Payroll (STP).



Manage employee leave balances, annual leave and personal leave.



Check overtime, allowances and applicable employee entitlements.



Reconcile payroll costs and ensure they are allocated correctly to projects.



Review Hubstaff timesheets and identify discrepancies.



Maintain accurate payroll records and employee information.



Work with our external accountant or payroll specialist where required.



Previous experience managing Australian payroll is essential.



3. Work in progress (WIP) and project costing



This is a particularly important part of the role.



We operate a project based business where jobs can run for several weeks or months, with customer payments linked to project milestones.



You must understand how to track work in progress and accurately report project financial performance.



Responsibilities include:



Prepare and maintain monthly WIP reports across all active projects.



Track actual project expenditure against approved budgets.



Monitor labour, materials, subcontractors and other project costs.



Review project completion percentages, costs incurred and estimated costs to complete.



Reconcile project costs, progress claims and customer invoicing.



Identify unbilled work, accrued costs and outstanding project commitments.



Help ensure revenue and costs are recognised in the correct reporting periods under the accounting policies set by our accountant.



Identify jobs running over budget and flag potential margin losses early.



Prepare final job costing reports showing actual gross profit against estimated profit.



Investigate discrepancies and explain why projects performed above or below budget.



You should be comfortable working with project managers and operations staff to obtain accurate financial information.



4. Cash flow and financial reporting



Prepare and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts.



Track expected customer payments and upcoming supplier obligations.



Identify potential cash shortages before they occur.



Prepare weekly debtor and creditor reports.



Provide management with clear visibility over cash available and payments due.



Prepare monthly profit and loss reports and assist with balance sheet reviews.



Report on actual project margins and overall business profitability.



Identify unusual expenses, financial risks and opportunities to reduce costs.



Help improve budgeting, forecasting and financial controls.



We want someone who can explain what the numbers mean, not simply produce reports.



5. Financial systems and process improvement



Help improve our accounting procedures and internal controls.



Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting tasks.



Improve the flow of financial information between Xero, spreadsheets and our project management systems.



Maintain accurate project cost allocation and reporting.



Help management develop more reliable financial dashboards.



Take initiative when you identify something that could be done better.



Who we're looking for



You must have:



At least 5 years of relevant accounting or senior bookkeeping experience.



Advanced Xero experience.



Demonstrated experience processing Australian payroll.



Strong understanding of Australian GST, PAYG, superannuation and payroll requirements.



Experience preparing and reconciling WIP reports.



Strong construction or project costing experience.



Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Experience managing cash flow forecasting and financial reporting.



Strong understanding of profit and loss statements and balance sheets.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Exceptional attention to detail.



Confidence to question incorrect information and investigate discrepancies.



The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and take ownership of problems.



Experience working for an Australian construction, engineering or project based business will be highly regarded.



Formal accounting qualifications such as CPA, CA or equivalent will also be highly regarded.



What will make you successful



We want someone who takes ownership rather than waits for instructions.



If a supplier invoice looks wrong, you investigate it.



If a customer hasn't paid, you follow it up.



If a project is running over budget, you flag it.



If payroll doesn't reconcile, you work out why.



If the WIP report doesn't reflect what's happening on site, you investigate it.



If cash flow is going to be tight, you tell management early.



If you see a better way to manage something, you suggest it.



We need someone who can think independently, take responsibility and become a trusted part of our management team.



Working arrangements



This is a full time remote position, 40 hours per week.



You'll need to be available during agreed working hours with reasonable overlap with our Australian operations.



While working, you'll be expected to be logged into our online office so you can communicate directly with the team throughout your shift.



We use Hubstaff for time tracking, and payments are made fortnightly through Wise.



This is a long term opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of an important part of our business.



How to apply



Please send us:



A short introduction explaining your accounting experience.



Details of your Xero experience, particularly with Australian businesses.



Examples of Australian payroll you have managed, including superannuation, PAYG and STP.



Details of your experience preparing WIP reports and tracking construction project profitability.

title: Business Law Attorney / Paralegal
description:
About Ensign Partners



Ensign Partners brings simplicity to complexity by integrating legal, financial, tax, insurance, and advisory expertise under one roof. Our clients receive one coordinated plan, one trusted team, and a clear path forward.



We are a values-driven firm built on professionalism, trust, and long-term relationships. Every role at Ensign matters. We believe exceptional client experiences are created through consistency, accuracy, and people who take pride in doing things the right way.



Position Overview



Ensign Partners is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Business Law Attorney / Paralegal to support our growing business law practice.



We are especially interested in candidates who are licensed attorneys in the Philippines or have significant experience supporting U.S. business law attorneys.



This role will focus on preparing and reviewing business legal documents, drafting contracts and agreements, assisting with business formations and transactions, managing legal workflows, and ensuring matters progress accurately and efficiently from start to finish.



You will work closely with our U.S.-based attorneys and legal team to prepare high-quality legal documents, conduct legal research, maintain organized client files, and support a wide range of business legal matters.



This position is ideal for someone with a strong legal background who enjoys drafting and reviewing contracts, understands business structures and transactions, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a professional, detail-oriented environment.



Key Responsibilities



· Draft, prepare, and revise business legal documents using attorney instructions, approved templates, and established procedures.



· Assist with business entity formation, including LLCs, corporations, partnerships, and related organizational documents.



· Prepare and review business agreements, including:



o Operating Agreements



o Shareholder and Partnership Agreements



o Buy-Sell Agreements



o Independent Contractor Agreements



o Employment Agreements



o Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality Agreements



o Service and Vendor Agreements



o Commercial Contracts



o Asset Purchase and Business Sale Agreements



o Corporate Resolutions and Governance Documents



· Support mergers, acquisitions, and other business transactions through document preparation, due diligence, and coordination.



· Assist with corporate maintenance, annual filings, ownership changes, and entity compliance documentation.



· Conduct legal research related to U.S. business law under attorney direction.



· Review documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting, consistency, and potential issues requiring attorney attention.



· Prepare documents for attorney review and incorporate revisions as directed.



· Track outstanding tasks, deadlines, and legal matters to ensure efficient workflow.



· Maintain organized electronic client files and legal document management systems.



· Follow established systems, templates, checklists, and workflows consistently.



· Maintain the highest level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.



· Support additional business law and administrative projects as assigned.



Required Qualifications



· Legal education, paralegal training, or professional experience in business law, corporate law, commercial contracts, or related legal work.



· Experience drafting, reviewing, or preparing legal documents and business agreements.



· Strong understanding of contracts, business entities, and general corporate legal principles.



· Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and document preparation skills.



· Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



· Strong legal research, proofreading, and analytical abilities.



· Ability to manage multiple legal matters simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.



· Ability to work independently while following attorney instructions and established procedures.



· Professional demeanor with a strong commitment to quality, confidentiality, and meeting deadlines.



· Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.



Preferred Qualifications



· Licensed attorney in the Philippines — a significant advantage.



· Prior experience working with U.S.-based attorneys, law firms, or business clients.



· Experience with U.S. business law, corporate transactions, and contract drafting.



· Experience preparing LLC Operating Agreements, Buy-Sell Agreements, and other corporate governance documents.



· Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence and transaction documentation.



· Experience with business entity formation and corporate compliance.



· Familiarity with U.S. legal terminology, document formatting, and legal procedures.



· Experience with Clio or other legal practice management software.



· Experience with legal document management systems and electronic signature platforms.



· Strong ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and potential legal issues for attorney review.



· Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and improve legal workflows.



Why Join Ensign Partners?



Ensign Partners is intentional about building a workplace where people are trusted, supported, and held to high standards. This role is an important part of helping business owners protect, operate, and grow their businesses with confidence.



Joining Ensign means:



· Being part of a mission-driven, people-first firm.



· Working in a professional, organized, and collaborative environment.



· Having clear expectations and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.



· Working alongside experienced U.S. attorneys and legal professionals.



· Gaining exposure to a variety of business law matters, contracts, and transactions.



· Contributing meaningfully to a growing and respected organization.



· Building a long-term career with opportunities for professional growth.



If you have a strong legal background, enjoy working with business contracts and corporate legal matters, and are committed to producing exceptional legal work with accuracy and professionalism, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Ensign Partners team.



Philippine licensed attorneys with strong English communication skills and an interest in U.S. business law are strongly encouraged to apply.

 us directly.

 us outside of this job post, you will be automatically disqualified.

Business Law Attorney / Paralegal at Ensign Partners

· A short introduction.



· Your legal education and whether you are a licensed attorney in the Philippines.



· Your years of experience in business law, corporate law, or contract preparation.



· Whether you have experience working with U.S. attorneys or U.S. law firms.

· Which legal software and document management systems you have used.



· Your English proficiency level.



· Your expected monthly salary in USD.



PAY WILL DEPEND ON LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS.



Work hours will be full-time U.S. (Arizona) business hours.

title: Transaction Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

Experience with eXp Realty workflows and compliance standards is a strong preference.



Key Responsibilities

Daily & Ongoing Coordination

 & Communication: Serve as a primary contact for transaction-related
s. Clear document requirements, proactively follow up on missing files, and chase down outstanding signatures.



SkySlope Management: Upload, organize, and assign documents to the correct files daily. Continuously update transaction statuses to ensure compliance.



Document & Signature Coordination: Prepare and send document packages for signatures (e.g., SPDS, CLUE, BINSR, disclosures). Ensure all executed forms are promptly uploaded to SkySlope.



Transaction Tracking: Maintain the central tracking spreadsheet daily with current file statuses, received/missing documents, and signature status.

Closing Updates (Weekly / Upon Closing): Closely monitor files scheduled to close in the current week. Once officially closed, update the tracking spreadsheet with the closing date and flag any lingering post-closing requirements.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 1–3+ years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator or Compliance Specialist.



eXp Realty Familiarity: Prior experience navigating eXp Realty's compliance systems, file structures, and state-specific forms is highly preferred (nice to have).



Platform Proficiency: Advanced hands-on experience with SkySlope, standard e-signature tools, and spreadsheet management (Google Sheets / Excel).

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Part-Time): Ads and Social
description:
About Us

We are a small Australian performance marketing consultancy running Google and Meta ads for brands in Australia, Europe and the US. Our founder worked at Google and Meta. We all work remotely.



The Role

A short-form video editor who thinks while editing. We give you the script, the footage and a written standard. You return tight, premium videos that need few revisions, and you tell us before you start if something in the brief does not add up. You do not write scripts or concepts.



The first month is a probation month on our own content: about 5 short videos a week, each with versions for each channel, plus a visual for each of our 4 monthly blog posts (a website and a LinkedIn version). Once that runs well, you also edit ad videos for our clients, starting with a European consumer-finance brand.



Hours and Pay

About 20 hours a week, overlapping Melbourne time. Probation month: US$600. From month two, as client work starts, your rate rises with the work, up to US$1,000 a month for about 20 hours a week. Monthly contract.



What Good Looks Like

* Vertical videos, 6 to 60 seconds (9:16, 1080 x 1920, 1:1 1080 x 1080). Script, hook and call to action used exactly as written.

* Tight, natural pacing with no dead air. In ads, a new shot every 1 to 1.5 seconds. Every image matches the line under it, premium footage only.

* Shorts and variants with different images and a different first 3 seconds.

* Every line on screen for sound off. Every figure matches the source exactly.

* Each brand’s written standard followed, checked by you before you send.

* On time, revisions within 24 hours, and early questions instead of late surprises.



Real, Not Generated

Our own brand: no AI images, voices or avatars. Client work: real footage always, with AI voice-over or versioning where the client uses it.



How We Hire

Paid test 1, US$25: a 30-second video from our footage and a one-page checklist. The best two or three then get paid test 2, US$75: a 15-second ad and an 8-second short from a script, stock footage and a brand standard.



How To Apply

Start your message with the word “margin”. Then answer:



1. Links to two or three vertical videos you edited, ideally ads, as public links (YouTube, Vimeo, or Google Drive set to “anyone with the link”). Which were for brands in Australia, Europe, the UK or the US?

2. Your monthly rate in US dollars for about 20 hours a week, and your hourly rate.

3. A video that needed more than two rounds of revisions: what caused it, and what do you do now to prevent it?

4. A mistake you caught before it went out: what happened?



Short and honest beats long and polished.

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | Demand Gen, Lead Generation & Multi-Account Growth
description:
We’re looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Google Ads specialist to manage multiple accounts with substantial advertising budgets and help generate more qualified leads and customers.



You should be confident owning both strategy and day-to-day execution. Strong Google Demand Gen experience is essential, alongside advanced Search campaign management, lead magnets, conversion tracking, landing-page optimisation, and customer acquisition strategy.



We need someone who can understand each business, identify opportunities, manage budgets carefully, and explain how their work contributes to commercial results.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Manage multiple accounts through Google Ads Manager Account (MCC), with clear priorities, disciplined budget pacing, and consistent oversight.

• Build, audit, optimise, and scale Search and Demand Gen campaigns.

• Develop account structures, bidding strategies, targeting, audience segmentation, exclusions, and budget allocation suited to each business.

• Create acquisition strategies around customer intent, compelling offers, and lead magnets, with a clear path from initial interest to qualified enquiry and customer.

• Research keywords, search terms, competitors, and customer needs. Write and test ad copy and provide clear creative briefs.

• Improve landing pages, forms, and conversion journeys through structured testing.

• Set up, audit, and troubleshoot measurement using Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and CRM or offline conversion data.

• Use qualified-lead, sales, and customer acquisition data to guide optimisation and budget decisions.

• Evaluate Performance Max and remarketing opportunities where appropriate.

• Report clearly on performance, explain what changed, and recommend the next actions.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Substantial hands-on Google Ads experience, including personally managing several accounts at the same time.

• A proven record of managing significant per-account budgets responsibly and improving business outcomes.

• Demonstrable Google Demand Gen experience, including audience strategy, creative testing, and assessment of lead quality or customer results.

• Experience using lead magnets, offers, and landing-page tests within a broader acquisition strategy.

• Strong knowledge of conversion tracking and how to connect advertising activity with CRM and sales outcomes.

• The ability to diagnose problems across campaigns, tracking, landing pages, and the sales funnel.

• Clear communication, reliable execution, and the confidence to explain recommendations and trade-offs.



Success in this role means increasing qualified leads and customer acquisition while maintaining control of spend and acquisition costs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• Two or three brief case studies. For each, state the business type, advertising spend, currency, reporting period, results, and exactly what you personally managed. Anonymised examples are welcome.

• At least one Google Demand Gen example. Explain the strategy, what you tested, and the results or lessons.

• The number of accounts you have managed concurrently and the typical and largest budgets you have personally handled.

• A short summary of your GA4, Google Tag Manager, CRM, and offline conversion tracking experience.

• Your availability, earliest start date, and expected rate, including the currency and whether it is hourly or monthly.



Finally, in a few sentences: if an account generates more leads but sales are not improving, what would you investigate first, and why?



We are looking for clear evidence of hands-on expertise, sound judgment, and measurable results.

title: WordPress Gutenberg / Block Developer – Contract, Remote
description:
About the Position

We are a U.S. based marketing agency seeking an experienced WordPress Gutenberg / Block Developer to support ongoing client website and landing page projects.

This is a hands-on development position for someone who can work independently, take a project through development and QA, troubleshoot issues, and deliver clean, responsive, production-ready WordPress websites.

Strong Gutenberg experience is required.

Our websites are built primarily using the native WordPress Gutenberg / Block Editor and proof of experience using this platform is REQUIRED. If your WordPress experience is primarily based on Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or similar page builders, your experience will not meet our requirements for this position.



What You’ll Be Doing

You will work with our agency partners and project team to:

• Build complete WordPress websites using Gutenberg and native WordPress functionality

• Build custom Gutenberg blocks

• Create and manage block patterns and reusable/synced patterns

• Develop and customize WordPress themes and child themes

• Build conversion-focused landing pages

• Modify and improve existing WordPress websites

• Integrate WordPress websites with third-party platforms and APIs

• Troubleshoot plugin, theme, compatibility, and performance issues

• Optimize websites for speed and Core Web Vitals

• Ensure proper responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

• Follow accessibility and WCAG best practices

• Create and work within staging environments

• Manage backups and rollback procedures before major changes

• Configure and troubleshoot SSL

• Deploy approved changes from staging to production

• Perform cross-browser and device testing

• Provide ongoing WordPress maintenance and troubleshooting

• Estimate development hours before beginning assigned projects

• Document custom development when appropriate



Additional Tech Stack Used

• Smart Slider 3

• Google Site Kit

• Insert Scripts/Snippets 

• Gravity Forms, WPforms Contact Forms 7 and custom CSS styling with HTML 

• Link Whisperer

• Rank Math Pro

• Some Elementor client work may be required 

• Call Tracking Metrics, Callrail, or Liine

• Advanced Custom Fields 

• Woocommerce 

• Google Recaptcha

• CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)

• Page Speed Insights 

• GTMetrix 

• Additional plugins may be required.

• Cookies Yes or other Cookie tracking platforms 

• Accessibility plugins like Accessibe



Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience

• 3+ years of professional experience with the Gutenberg / WordPress Block Editor

• Strong experience building websites with native Gutenberg blocks

• Ability to build complete WordPress websites independently

• Experience creating custom Gutenberg blocks and block patterns

• Understanding of responsive web design and ability to determine appropriate responsive behavior when every breakpoint is not provided

• Experience integrating WordPress with third-party APIs and platforms

• Ability to troubleshoot WordPress issues independently

• Strong understanding of website performance and optimization

• Ability to work with staging and production environments

• Strong attention to detail and quality assurance

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to communicate clearly about project status, questions, estimates, and technical issues

• Reliable availability during agreed-upon U.S. Pacific Time working hours



Additional Technical Skills

Experience with the following is preferred:

• HTML5

• CSS3

• JavaScript

• PHP

• React

• WordPress REST API

• Git / GitHub

• Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)

• Custom Post Types

• Full Site Editing (FSE)

• theme.json

• WordPress block themes

• WooCommerce

• WP-CLI

• MySQL

• Site migrations



Hosting & Deployment

You should be comfortable working with WordPress hosting environments, particularly:

• Bluehost

• WP Engine

• Staging environments

• Website backups and restoration

• SSL

• Production deployments

Experience performing WordPress site migrations is a plus.



Marketing & Analytics Awareness

You will not be responsible for managing our clients’ analytics or advertising platforms. However, you should understand that agency websites frequently contain marketing and conversion tracking that must be preserved during development.

Familiarity with the following is helpful:

• Google Tag Manager

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

• Google Ads conversion tracking

• Meta Pixel

• CallTrackingMetrics and/or CallRail

• Cookie consent platforms

• Google Consent Mode

• SEO fundamentals

• Schema markup

• Core Web Vitals

Developers must be careful not to remove, duplicate, or break existing analytics, advertising, SEO, or conversion-tracking functionality when modifying client websites.



Development Standards

We expect professional development practices on every project.

This includes:

• Clean, maintainable development

• Using native WordPress functionality whenever practical

• Avoiding unnecessary plugins

• No pirated, nulled, or unauthorized themes or plugins

• Cross-browser testing

• Desktop, tablet, and mobile QA

• Page-speed and performance optimization

• Development and testing in staging before production deployment

• Creating backups before significant website changes

• Documentation of custom development

• Testing changes before considering a task complete



Design & UI/UX

While our team will generally provide design elements, we are looking for a developer with a good visual eye and understanding of UI/UX.

You should be able to recognize spacing, typography, hierarchy, alignment, responsive behavior, and usability issues rather than simply building exactly what is shown without considering how the page functions across different screen sizes.



How We Work

You will work directly with our agency partners and internal team rather than our clients.

We currently use:

• Asana

• Wrike

• Discord

You should be comfortable receiving assignments, reviewing designs and requirements, asking questions when necessary, estimating the development time required, and then independently completing the work.

Clear communication is extremely important.



AI-Assisted Development

We are comfortable with our team using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI development tools to improve productivity.

However, you are responsible for all code you deploy.

You must understand, review, test, secure, and be able to troubleshoot any AI-assisted code before it is implemented on a client website.



How to Apply

• Please provide the following:

• A brief introduction describing your WordPress and Gutenberg development experience.

• 3–5 live WordPress websites you personally worked on that use Gutenberg.

• Examples of custom Gutenberg blocks you have developed.

• For each example, briefly explain your specific role and what you personally developed.

• GitHub profile or code samples, if available.

• Your current availability and approximate number of hours available per week.

• Your time zone and the hours you can consistently work during U.S. Pacific Time.

• Your current internet speed and a brief description of your workstation/setup.

• Confirm that you are comfortable with the posted $8.00 USD/hour contract rate.



Important

We are specifically looking for a WordPress Gutenberg developer, not simply someone familiar with WordPress page builders. 



This means you MUST have a portfolio with Generate Press, Generate Blocks on a generate press child theme. 

Please do not apply if the majority of your WordPress development experience is based on Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or similar visual page builders. We do have clients that onboard with Wix, Squarespace, Webflow or Elementor but we typically request they move to GeneratePress.



We are looking for someone dependable who can become a trusted development resource for ongoing project-based work. Strong performance can lead to additional projects and increased hours.

--------------------

You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording:



****Respond with your own words WITHOUT entering this scenario into AI and generating a script because we'll know****



Record a voice note covering the specific scenario below:



*A commercial facility director left a $10000 Harvest Equipment setup in their cart yesterday. You are calling them back. You are introducing yourself, and the buyer pushes pack:

title: Event Coordination VA for Fast-Growing Events Company in Australia

- Submit an updated CV in a PDF format



Applications missing either the Loom video or the CV will NOT be considered.



Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events. Each event runs across multiple days with 20–25+ vendors, a full marketing campaign, and a long list of suppliers to book and confirm. They run on a repeating monthly cycle, which means there is always one event in delivery and another in build.



We need a remote Event Operations Coordinator to own the moving parts from the moment an event is confirmed through to post-event close-out.



This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d
 the event theme, the commercial model or which vendors get accepted. You will be the person who makes sure everything that was d
 actually happens, on time.



What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Tracking vendor marketing compliance — required posts, countdown banners, event shares — and chasing before every posting deadline

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

- Updating the event website in WordPress/Elementor each cycle — dates, venue, map, parking, FAQs, vendor lineup, competition, images — and testing every link on desktop and mobile

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Supplier and infrastructure bookings: power, cool rooms, equipment hire, barriers and lighting, cleaning and waste, security — booking, confirming, and following up delivery and collection

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

- Vendor commissions, reconciliation, and the final post-event report



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating events, projects or operations remotely. Events experience is a strong bonus, but disciplined project coordination in any industry is highly regarded

- You are relentless about following up. A large part of this role is chasing people who haven't replied — politely, repeatedly, without being asked to

- Strongly detail-oriented, with a habit of recording proof rather than just marking things done

- Hands-on with WordPress and Elementor, or able to demonstrate you can learn it quickly — you'll be editing event pages yourself, not raising tickets

- Confident with task management tools, spreadsheets,
 marketing platforms and social scheduling

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main point of contact for dozens of vendors and suppliers

- Good judgement about what you handle yourself versus what you escalate

- Able to hold a lot of concurrent deadlines across two overlapping event cycles without dropping any



What success looks like:

- You've run at least one full event cycle end to end, from confirmation to close-out

- The tracker is current every working day and nothing sits overdue without being flagged

- Vendor compliance documents are collected ahead of deadline rather than chased in the final week

- The end-of-day report is running consistently and management is relying on it

- A complete post-event report has been delivered covering attendance, vendor sales, marketing performance and key learnings

title: STATIC ADS TRANSLATOR
description:
We are an Ecommerce company in the health and beauty niche industry (mainly supplements, creams, oils, etc) currently selling only on Meta.

BENEFITS:

- Long term role for years to come: we value trust and loyalty

- Salary will be 4$ per hour to start 

- Flexible hours - 6 days a week

- Work load of approximately 8 hours per day

- Be part of our team



RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS:



You will translate batches of statics in different languages via our translation tool as we run ads in 10 different countries.

You'll need to follow strict guidelines and adjust the details from the original statics to make the translation accurate.

Once the batch has been translated in the 10 countries, you will be responsible for ensuring correct naming and files organisation following our conventions.



We need someone who pays attention to details and can adjust based on our feedback. Our ideal prospect is also not afraid to ask questions and always double checks his work.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Detail-oriented and independent (will double check his / her own)

- Experience in static ads translation via Canva

- Available 6 days a week (no other job allowed, you will only work for us)

- Fast internet connection / backup generator in case of power outage

- Calm and focused environment (crucial)

- Answers promptly and ready to hop on a call during shift hours

- Tech-savvy and can easily navigate Google sheets and Canva

- Emotional intelligence and strong communication / can clearly enunciate any issue encountered or asks questions if needed





VIDEO LOOM APPLICATION:



If you've read this whole job post, send me a message starting with “READY” and answer precisely the next questions after briefly introducing yourself (age, city, marital status, etc) in a short loom video:



1. What is your current situation ? Any imperatives such as family, church, studies, etc.

We expect you to be available 6 days a week as this is a full time role and are looking for someone who will be part of our team only (no other company work allowed).

No need to go into details but we must know what is taking up your time outside of work.

Exemple: “I go to Church every Sunday from 8 to 11am approximately”.

Or “I might need to take care of my relatives on that day” etc.



2. Where do you live exactly in the Philippines and what’s your internet speed ?

We expect you to have a backup solution in case of power outage.



3. Give us a detailed breakdown of your prior work experience and study curriculum if applicable (both remote and non remote work).

You will also explain why your contract ended for each job.

Example: “I worked for a video editing company from June 2023 to July 2025. During that time, I only worked for that company for which my only task was to edit videos following their guidelines.

My contract with them stopped as their company stopped operating in July 2025.”

Include all contracts / jobs even if contract were not related to static ads or if contract lasted for a week.



Please be honest in your answers. We value trust and long term commitment.

Looking forward to have you in the team and develop our relationship :)



William

title: Virtual Assistant for Renovation Operations (Estimator or Builder Background Preferred)
description:
HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY!!!)

Please submit the following:

- A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for the role.

- Attach a copy of your most recent and updated CV.



Applications without a Loom video and updated CV will not be considered. Please speak naturally in your video rather than reading from a prepared script.



Summary

We’re looking for a sharp, proactive and highly organised Renovation Operations Virtual Assistant to support the renovation lead of a fast-moving property investment and renovation business based in regional Australia. Candidates with a background as an estimator, builder, quantity surveyor or site supervisor are strongly preferred.



Our renovation lead currently oversees more than 20 active renovation projects. His workday moves fast and is often shaped by what’s happening on site: trade availability, materials, property access, urgent repairs, payments, compliance requirements and changing project priorities.



Your role is to bring structure and follow-through to this workload. You’ll turn calls, voice messages,
s, photos, videos and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks, then make sure those tasks keep moving until they’re done.



This is not a traditional inbox-and-calendar Executive Assistant role. It’s a hands-on coordination and operations position for someone who can work quickly, use practical judgement, follow up confidently and take ownership without needing constant supervision.



What you’ll be doing

- Managing renovation tasks, deadlines, notes and follow-ups in ClickUp

- Turning
s, calls, voice messages, photos and site updates into clear action items

- Monitoring projects and identifying urgent tasks, blockers and missing information

- Preparing and updating scopes of work and trade job briefs

- Preparing preliminary costings, quantities and estimates for renovation work

- Following up with trades, contractors, suppliers and other parties

- Sourcing trades in regional Australian areas

- Maintaining contractor details, quotes, waivers, access information and property records

- Researching Australian rental, safety and property-compliance requirements

- Preparing concise project updates covering progress, blockers and next steps

- Creating practical checklists, templates and SOPs

- Communicating delays early and giving clear completion estimates



Who we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have a background as an estimator, builder, quantity surveyor or site supervisor (preferred), or experience in construction, renovation, property maintenance, project coordination or operations support

- Can read plans, scopes and inspection reports, and tell cosmetic work apart from work that needs a licensed trade

- Can produce realistic renovation cost estimates, not new-build figures

- Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

- Can organise incomplete or fast-moving information into clear next steps

- Take ownership and follow tasks through without repeated reminders

- Are confident following up with trades, contractors and suppliers

- Can manage multiple projects and competing priorities

- Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

- Give timely updates and raise blockers early

- Respond well to feedback and adapt quickly

- Are comfortable with ClickUp, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and online document-management tools

- Can accurately track your working time

- Have reliable internet, a suitable workspace and consistent availability



Highly regarded experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

- Residential construction or renovation

- Construction estimating or quantity surveying

- Architecture, interior design or civil engineering

- Sourcing and coordinating trades in Australia

- Australian building, rental or property-compliance requirements



Estimator and builder backgrounds will be prioritised. We’ll also consider fast learners with strong initiative, practical judgement and a genuine interest in renovation operations.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Long Form + Shorts) for a Lighting Brand
description:
YouTube Video Editor: Long-Form + Shorts | Haven Lighting | Remote, Ongoing



Haven Lighting designs and builds permanent roofline, landscape and hardscape lighting, all controlled from one app, and we train the professional installers who sell and install it across the US.



We're growing our YouTube channel, hosted by our founder, Chris. We need one reliable editor who can make every video look as good as our products.



What you'll edit each week



1 long video (6–12 minutes): real service calls from our weekly "Lights Out Tuesday" series, how-to design and install guides, and the business of running a lighting company.



5 vertical Shorts (20–60 seconds) for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and
, mostly cut from the same footage.



1 thumbnail per long video, made from our own footage.



A caption file (.srt) and a plain-text transcript with every final video.



What you'll get from us



Raw 4K phone footage from our Tuesday field day in a shared folder by Wednesday morning, plus a short brief: the hook, key points, chapters and the best Shorts moments with timestamps.



A fixed open and close that stays the same in every service-call video (we'll show you exactly how).



Clear feedback: one combined list of notes within 24 hours, with up to two revision rounds per video.



Steady, long-term work.



Weekly timing



Long video first draft: Friday.



Shorts first drafts: the following Monday.



Finals: within 48 hours of our notes.



You're a fit if you



Have edited how-to, trades, home-improvement or talking-head-plus-B-roll videos for real YouTube channels (not only a demo reel).



Know retention editing: a strong first 5 seconds, no dead air, clean readable captions, good pacing, without meme sounds, zoom spam or cheap effects. Our look is premium and clean.



Read English well. You'll cut technical explanations (transformers, low-voltage wiring, rooflines, app zones), and captions must be spelled right.



Can find the story in messy real-job footage.



Work in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut Pro, and deliver organized project files.



Overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern time, and hit deadlines every week.



How we work



Shared-folder access only. You'll never need our YouTube or social logins.



Music only from libraries we license; fonts and stock properly licensed.



All footage, edits, thumbnails and project files belong to Haven Lighting. We sign a simple contractor agreement before paid work starts.



Pay: up to $1,200 USD per month for the full weekly scope, based on experience and your test edit. Finalists do a paid test edit ($100) from real Haven footage, then a 30-day paid trial.



To apply, send:



Start with the words "Pro Tips", so we know you read this post.



3 links to YouTube videos you edited, including at least one Short, and what you did on each.



Your monthly rate for the scope above.



Your time zone and working hours.



One sentence: what makes a how-to video worth watching to the end?



Applications without live YouTube links won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Video Editor | Product Demos, Sales Videos, YouTube & Short Form
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled video editor who can produce polished, engaging videos across both long form and short form.



The work will include product demonstrations, sales videos, YouTube content, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms. We need someone with excellent creative judgment who understands storytelling, pacing, visual presentation, and how to hold attention while delivering a clear message.



Your portfolio should demonstrate a consistently high standard of editing, with strong examples of both longer videos and short social content.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Edit product demos and sales videos that clearly explain features, communicate benefits, and guide viewers towards the next step.

• Produce engaging long form YouTube videos with strong structure, storytelling, and purposeful pacing.

• Create Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and other short form content with compelling hooks and clear messaging.

• Turn longer videos into effective standalone clips, adapting the framing, captions, story, and timing for each platform.

• Add clean motion graphics, animated text, screen recordings, product callouts, and supporting visuals.

• Polish dialogue, music, sound effects, colour, and overall visual consistency.

• Work from briefs and feedback while contributing your own creative ideas.

• Keep footage, project files, and versions organised, meet agreed deadlines, and communicate progress clearly.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A strong portfolio showing high-quality long form and short form editing, including commercial, product, or sales content.

• Excellent judgment in pacing, shot selection, storytelling, typography, music, and sound.

• Advanced proficiency in professional editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro.

• Strong motion graphics capability using After Effects or an equivalent tool.

• The ability to make thoughtful creative decisions and deliver polished work beyond basic cuts, captions, and template assembly.

• Attention to detail across subtitles, audio levels, colour, brand consistency, aspect ratios, and final exports.

• The ability to work independently, respond constructively to feedback, and take an edit through to completion.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• Direct links to at least 2 long form videos and 3 short form videos that demonstrate your strongest work. Include product demos or sales videos where available.

• A brief explanation of your personal contribution to each example, including editing, motion graphics, sound, colour, or creative direction.

• One example of an editing decision you made that improved a video’s clarity, engagement, or persuasiveness.

• Your main editing and motion graphics tools.

• Your availability, earliest start date, and expected rate. Please state the currency and whether your rate is hourly, monthly, or per project.



Please make sure all portfolio links are accessible and include any viewing passwords.



We will assess the quality, creative judgment, and relevance of your work. Choose examples that show the standard you can consistently deliver.

title: Social Media Video Editor
description:
[[ Only applicants who submit their information here will be considered for interview:
 ]]



Location: Remote



Rate: $6 - $8/hour



Employment Type: Contractor



Schedule:

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time (PST),

Monday - Friday (Full time - 8 hours - 1 hour lunch break)

**Candidates must be available to work these hours based on our headquarters’ time zone.





About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Video & Content Editor to help us grow our social media presence, including YoutTube & Shorts, Reels, and TikTok.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply splicing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how social media content works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.



Ideally, you also have experience creating long-form content for YouTube with supporting graphic design skills for thumbnails.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.

title: US B2B Sales Closer (AI Voice Assistant) | $10/hr + Commission
description:
We are looking for ONE Philippines-based B2B Sales Closer with experience personally closing paid deals with US business owners.



We are preparing to launch an AI voice assistant service, starting with emergency plumbing companies in Houston, Texas. This is an early-stage project: we are preparing the demo and sales process and building the prospect pipeline.



This role focuses on scheduled demos, sales follow-ups, and closing paid pilots. Cold calling will be handled separately.



THE PRODUCT



The planned service answers incoming calls when a business owner or team cannot pick up, collects the caller’s details and service request, and escalates urgent requests until a specific on-call technician confirms acceptance.



The goal is to help service businesses capture missed inquiries and give each urgent request a clearly responsible person.



PAY, HOURS & TRIAL



• $10 USD per hour for agreed preparation, demos, follow-ups, and reporting.

• Commission per closed paid pilot. The amount, payment trigger, and payout timing will be agreed in writing before you start.

• Initial planning estimate: approximately 3–5 hours per week. Actual hours depend on booked demos and agreed tasks; a fixed weekly volume is not guaranteed.

• A two-week paid trial at the same hourly rate.

• Scheduled demos during Houston business hours, which generally means evening or night work in the Philippines.

• The start date and demo schedule will be agreed before the trial.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Prepare for and conduct scheduled product demos once the demo and sales materials are ready.

• Understand how each business currently handles missed calls and urgent requests.

• Explain the offer clearly and accurately.

• Handle questions and objections about value, price, reliability, and existing answering services.

• Follow up with interested prospects and guide suitable clients toward a paid pilot.

• Keep clear records of next steps, outcomes, objections, and reasons for lost deals.



REQUIREMENTS



• Experience personally closing paid B2B deals with US clients.

• Strong spoken English and confidence speaking with business owners.

• Ability to conduct demos, handle objections, and follow up through to payment.

• Reliable internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability for scheduled calls during US Central Time business hours.

• Experience selling SaaS, AI, or business services is an advantage.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short summary of your US B2B closing experience: products or services, industries, and typical deal sizes.

2. One specific paid deal you personally closed: what you sold, the amount paid, your responsibilities, what other team members handled, and the approximate time from first contact to payment.

3. A 60–90 second English voice recording demonstrating how you would open a demo with a Houston plumbing company owner.

4. Your availability in US Central Time.

5. Confirmation that $10/hour plus a commission agreed before starting, variable demo-based hours, and a two-week paid trial work for you.



Start your application with “Houston Closer”.

description:
## Virtual Assistant — Adjusted Wellness (Chiropractic & Functional Medicine)



**About us**

Adjusted Wellness is a growing chiropractic and functional medicine practice bringing on roughly 15 new patients a month, with a functional medicine diagnostics line (full blood panel, gut barrier testing) alongside standard care. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant whose entire job is taking as much as possible off the doctor's plate — this role lives or dies on that, more than any single task on the list below.



**What you'll be doing**

- Manage the practice's calendar in Jane App — booking, rescheduling, and confirming appointments for new and existing patients

- Follow up by text/email with patients who paid a $250 deposit at their Report of Findings but haven't yet committed to their full care plan — track every one until they convert or clearly decline

- Send appointment reminders and reduce no-shows with a standard confirmation sequence (call/text 48 hrs and 24 hrs out)

- Handle inbound patient
s and texts — answer routine questions, route anything clinical to the doctor

- Data entry: new patient intake forms, payment info, superbills (we don't bill insurance directly — only issue superbills on request), and updates into Jane App

- Track and reorder supplement inventory (Microbiome Labs, Apex Energetics, Designs for Health) when stock runs low

- Coordinate monthly tabling events at partner gyms (Gold's Gym, Crunch Fitness) — confirm the date/time with the gym contact, prep sign-up sheets, follow up with leads collected

- Maintain a simple weekly report of patients booked, deposits collected, and follow-ups completed for the doctor's Friday review



**Must-have skills**

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable learning new software quickly (Jane App experience a plus, not required)

- Reliable internet (minimum 10 Mbps) and a quiet workspace

- Strong follow-through — proactive about finding more to take off the doctor's plate, not just completing the assigned list



**Nice to have**

- Prior experience in a medical, chiropractic, or wellness practice

- Experience with patient scheduling software (Jane App, similar)

- Basic bookkeeping or spreadsheet comfort (Google Sheets / Excel)



**Hours & schedule**

Monday–Friday, part-time to start (10-20 hrs/week), US Eastern Time business hours. Potential to grow to full-time as responsibilities expand.



**Pay**

$4–7/hour depending on experience, paid biweekly. Starting estimate hours: roughly 10-20 hrs/week.



**How to apply**

Send a short video or written intro telling us: (1) your experience with patient scheduling or admin work, (2) a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem, (3) your available hours.
