title: B2B Business Development Coordinator / Appointment Setter — Leads Provided
description:
**B2B Business Development Coordinator / Appointment Setter — Leads Provided**



Journey of Returning (JOR) is a Miami-based bilingual marketing and customer acquisition consultancy helping businesses turn their positioning, content, digital presence, and customer journey into systems that create real business opportunities.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and professional **part-time Business Development Coordinator** to manage targeted outbound outreach and follow-up.



This is **not a high-volume spam or generic cold-calling role.**



We will provide the companies/prospects we want to pursue, the strategic reason we selected them, messaging direction, templates, and the offers being introduced.



Your responsibility is to make sure the right person is identified, contacted professionally, followed up with consistently, tracked correctly, and handed over when genuine interest develops.



### THE TWO OUTREACH PIPELINES



You will work across two primary prospect groups:



**1. Content-to-Customer Prospects**



Founder-led and service-based businesses that may benefit from JOR's Content-to-Customer Audit and broader marketing/customer-acquisition services.



**2. Spanish Market Expansion Prospects**



Established companies with proven English-language products or services that may have an opportunity to expand into Spanish-speaking markets through JOR's Spanish Revenue Pilot and bilingual growth services.



### MONTHLY OUTREACH TARGET



Our target is approximately:



**400 new prospects per month**



- 200 Content-to-Customer prospects

- 200 Spanish Market Expansion prospects

- approximately 100 new prospects per week when workflow allows



Prospects will generally be selected/provided by JOR.



Quality matters more than blindly reaching a quota. If active conversations, qualified opportunities, or follow-ups require attention, those take priority.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



**Prospect Enrichment**

- Identify the correct decision-maker at each approved company

- Research and verify professional
 addresses

- Locate relevant LinkedIn profiles

- Confirm job title and company information

- Keep prospect records organized and accurate



*
 Outreach**

- Send outreach using JOR-approved templates and messaging

- Personalize each message appropriately to the person/company

- Use the strategic observation or opportunity provided by JOR

- Avoid generic, mass-produced, or obviously AI-generated outreach

- Maintain professional follow-up sequences



**LinkedIn Outreach**

- Use LinkedIn selectively when it is the strongest direct communication channel

- Connect with appropriate prospects

- Send personalized outreach/follow-ups

- Track LinkedIn activity in our outreach system



The selected candidate will use their own legitimate LinkedIn profile and represent their role with Journey of Returning professionally. We do not use automated LinkedIn spam or unauthorized scraping tools.



**Follow-Up Management**

- Own the follow-up calendar

- Make sure interested or potentially interested leads never get forgotten

- Follow up professionally and consistently

- Re-engage prospects when appropriate

- Flag meaningful replies for Ashley immediately



**Warm Lead Reactivation**

- Follow up with previous JOR leads, conversations, prospects, or opportunities provided to you

- Reopen conversations professionally

- Identify leads that may now be ready for a conversation



**Appointment Setting**

- Identify genuine interest

- Transition qualified prospects to Ashley

- Coordinate and book meetings when appropriate

- Ensure meeting information and context are documented



**Pipeline & CRM Management**

Track each prospect through stages such as:



Approved  

Contact Identified  

Outreach Sent  

Follow-Up 1  

Follow-Up 2  

Responded  

Interested  

Meeting Requested  

Meeting Booked  

Not Now  

Not Interested  

Closed



**Weekly Reporting**



Provide a concise weekly update including:



- New prospects contacted

- Follow-ups completed

- Replies

- Positive replies

- Qualified opportunities

- Meetings booked

- Meetings held

- Pipeline issues or opportunities requiring attention



### HIGHER-VALUE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT RESPONSIBILITIES



As you become familiar with JOR, you may also help with:



- identifying referral or strategic partnership opportunities

- reactivating dormant prospects

- identifying companies showing potential buying signals

- flagging companies expanding into new markets

- identifying Spanish-language expansion opportunities

- monitoring previously contacted prospects for meaningful changes

- recommending prospects for future outreach batches



### WHAT YOU WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will not be expected to:



- create JOR's strategy

- select all prospects independently at the beginning

- negotiate pricing

- develop custom proposals

- promise results

- independently diagnose a company's marketing strategy

- close complex sales opportunities

- send generic mass spam



Ashley handles strategy, sales conversations, proposals, and closing.



Your role is to create and manage the pipeline that gets qualified prospects into those conversations.



### HOURS



This is a flexible part-time contractor role.



**Approximately  25–35 hours per month maximum.**



Weekly workload may vary. Some weeks may require more activity than others depending on new outreach batches, follow-ups, and active conversations.



We care about consistent execution and outcomes rather than requiring identical weekly hours.



### COMPENSATION



**$6 USD/hour**



Plus performance incentives:



- **$15** for each qualified meeting that actually takes place

- **$75** when a lead sourced/managed through your outreach purchases a JOR Content-to-Customer Audit

- **$100** when a lead sourced/managed through your outreach purchases a JOR Spanish Revenue Pilot



Additional compensation opportunities may be introduced as the role and results grow.



### WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should be:



- highly organized

- reliable with follow-up

- comfortable communicating with business owners and executives

- an excellent written English communicator

- detail-oriented

- comfortable with
 and LinkedIn outreach

- able to follow messaging guidelines closely

- capable of researching decision-makers and contact information

- comfortable working independently

- interested in business development, sales, marketing, or customer acquisition



Experience with B2B outreach, appointment setting, lead generation, CRM management, LinkedIn, or cold
 is strongly preferred.



Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is a plus.



### IMPORTANT



We are **not** looking for someone who believes sales means sending hundreds of identical messages.



Journey of Returning uses a selective, human-first approach.



We contact companies because we see a legitimate reason there may be a business fit. Your job is to help us execute that outreach professionally, consistently, and at scale without losing the human quality behind it.

title: Data Analyst (Python + AI tools), Sports Pricing Models, Full-Time
description:
Data Analyst (Python + AI tools), Sports Pricing Models, Full-Time



Type: Full-time

Hours: 40/week, some overlap with Philippine mornings (US evenings)

Pay: PHP 45,000-70,000/month depending on skill, after a paid trial



ABOUT US

We're a small proprietary trading team pricing sports markets on regulated US prediction markets: parlay quote requests (RFQs), player props for the NFL, NBA and MLB, and game lines. The quoting systems and data pipelines already run live. We're building our own correlation and player-prop models, and we need an analyst to help build and test them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and test player-prop probability models (minutes, usage, per-minute rates) against sportsbook closing lines.

- Measure correlation between legs of the same game (for example, a QB's passing yards and his receivers' yards) from historical play-by-play data.

- Backtest parlay pricing against millions of settled trades: where we win, where we get picked off, and why.

- Look for data leaks, look-ahead bias and overfitting before anything goes live.

- Use AI coding tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) daily to work fast, and check everything they produce.

- Write short, clear reports: what was tested, the result, how confident we are, and what to do next.



MUST HAVE

- Daily, hands-on use of AI tools for coding and analysis. You know where they help, where they make things up, and how to verify their output.

- Solid Python: pandas, numpy, Jupyter.

- Statistics fundamentals: probability, log loss, calibration, confidence intervals, train/test splits.

- Careful with numbers. You double-check before you report.

- Clear written English.

- Stable internet and your own computer.



NICE TO HAVE

- Sports betting or odds knowledge.

- Experience with sports data (nflverse, NBA stats APIs, play-by-play).

- SQL or parquet, scikit-learn, command line.

- A GitHub or Kaggle profile.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume, one piece of analysis you're proud of, and answers to two questions:



1. A model beats the market in a backtest by a tiny margin. What three things would you check before believing it?

2. Describe a time an AI tool gave you wrong code or a wrong answer. How did you catch it?

Verify fix resolutions and ensure no feature ships without explicit QA sign-off.

3. Project Board & Workflow Management

Categorize work items efficiently (e.g., features, bugs, enhancements, technical debt).

Make sure each task has an owner, priority, and target deadline/sprint.

Generate concise weekly progress reports for leadership.

4. Roadmap & Feature Support

Keep the functional product roadmap updated in line with management direction.

Aggregate and organize incoming feedback, user requests, and support tickets.

Assist in evaluating task priority based on impact vs. effort.

Draft feature briefs defining problem statements, proposed solutions, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.



Qualifications & Experience



Required:

    ClickUp

    Linear

Preferred / Bonus:

1. Prior background with SaaS or subscription-based platforms.

2. Experience in dental, orthodontic, healthcare, or health-tech software.

3. Experience writing agile/scrum user stories.

4. Basic understanding of web technologies such as APIs, databases, front-end, and back-end concepts.

5. Experience with Figma or other design tools for reviewing or annotating mockups.



How to Apply

Product coordination or project management

Working with developers

Project management tools you have used

title: n8n automation and AI systems specialist | Remote | Long term opportunity
description:
Raven Tanks is an Australian engineering and construction business specialising in water storage tanks, inspections, maintenance, refurbishment and installation projects.



We manage enquiries, estimating, sales, procurement, project delivery, scheduling and accounts across multiple systems.



We're looking for an experienced automation specialist to help connect these systems, reduce manual administration and improve how the business operates.



This is a hands on technical role.



We don't need someone to simply recommend automations. We need someone who can understand our processes, design the solution, build it, test it and get it working.



Systems we use



Pipedrive for CRM, sales and project tracking.



Gmail and Google Workspace for communications, documents and spreadsheets.



Google Drive for project files and documentation.



Xero for accounts and financial reporting.



ServiceM8 for field operations and scheduling.



Custom software currently being developed for asset management and inspection reporting.



Our preferred automation platform is n8n, although we are open to other suitable tools where there is a clear benefit.



What we want to build

Intelligent enquiry management



Automatically process incoming enquiries, extract relevant project information, identify missing details, match existing CRM records and assign work to the right team member.



AI assisted
 and RFI preparation



Read incoming
s and attachments, understand the client's requirements and prepare relevant responses or requests for information for staff approval.



Quotation follow ups



Connect Pipedrive and Gmail to identify outstanding quotes, monitor responses and prepare appropriate follow ups without sending unnecessary or duplicate
s.



Sales and operations handover



When a deal is won, automate the transfer of project details, creation or linking of job folders, handover documentation and required operational tasks.



Estimating assistance



Use AI to review specifications, drawings and project information, retrieve relevant historical pricing and assist our estimating team with preliminary budgets and quotation preparation.



Accounts integration



Connect Xero with our project systems to improve visibility of deposits, payment status, outstanding invoices, billing milestones and project costs.



Operations and reporting



Automate aspects of procurement, project updates, document tracking, field reporting and management alerts.



Asset inspections and recurring services



Connect inspection results and asset history with our CRM to identify maintenance requirements, prepare service reminders and create potential sales opportunities.



We have other automation opportunities across the business and expect the role to develop over time.



What we're looking for



You must have proven experience building and maintaining n8n workflows.



You should be comfortable with:



REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and third party integrations.



JavaScript, JSON and data transformation.



AI APIs, structured data extraction and document processing.



Connecting CRM,
, accounting and operational software.



Designing workflows with appropriate approval steps.



Error handling, retries, logging and preventing duplicate records.



Testing, troubleshooting and documenting completed workflows.



Experience with Pipedrive, Google Workspace, Xero or ServiceM8 is highly regarded.



Construction or engineering industry experience would be helpful but is not essential.



How we work



You will work directly with management to understand what we are trying to achieve.



We will provide examples of our existing processes, systems and the problems we want solved.



We expect you to propose practical solutions and implement them.



We prefer working software over lengthy meetings or complicated presentations.



You should be able to demonstrate progress regularly and explain what has been completed, what is being worked on and what is preventing progress.



All workflows must be built in company controlled accounts, properly tested and documented.



What success looks like



Within the first month, we would expect several useful automations operating successfully within the business.



Examples include automated enquiry processing, intelligent RFI drafting, quote follow up management and improved project handover.

How to apply

Details of your experience integrating business systems using APIs.

title: Residential Construction Permit Coordinator | NC, AL, GA (USA)
description:
We are a growing US residential construction company looking for an experienced Construction Permit Coordinator to take full ownership of our permitting process across multiple markets, primarily in North Carolina, Alabama, and Georgia.



We need someone who can independently research permit requirements, complete application packets, submit permits, communicate with building departments, manage approvals, and coordinate inspections.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT an architectural drafting or plan preparation position. We already have draftsmen who prepare our construction plans and drawings. Your responsibility is to use those completed plans to prepare and submit the required permit packages and manage the process through approval.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Research permitting requirements for residential construction projects across different cities, counties, and jurisdictions.

2. Identify required applications, forms, supporting documents, fees, and approvals.

3. Complete permit application packets accurately using plans and documents provided by our team.

4. Submit applications through municipal portals,
, or other approved methods.

5. Communicate directly with building departments, permit reviewers, and municipal officials.

6. Respond to corrections, requests for additional information, and outstanding requirements.

7. Coordinate with our draftsmen when additional documentation or plan revisions are needed.

8. Track every permit from preparation through final approval and issuance.

9. Coordinate required inspections with building departments and our construction team.

10. Maintain accurate records of applications, approvals, inspection results, and project statuses.



QUALIFICATIONS



1. Experience preparing and submitting US residential construction permits.

2. Understanding of building department requirements and permitting procedures.

3. Ability to independently identify and complete jurisdiction specific permit packages.

4. Experience communicating with US municipalities and building departments.

5. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

6. Excellent written and spoken English.

7. Availability during overlapping US Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred experience includes permitting in North Carolina, Alabama, or Georgia, residential remodeling, additions, ADUs, roofing, decks, and coordinating building inspections.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We want someone who can receive a project address, scope of work, and completed construction plans, then independently determine what is required to obtain the necessary permits.



You should be able to prepare the complete application package, submit it to the appropriate jurisdiction, communicate with reviewers, resolve administrative issues, coordinate necessary corrections, and follow through until permits are issued.



You will also coordinate inspections as construction progresses.



Our goal is to have one dependable person who owns this entire process rather than requiring our construction managers to chase permits and inspections.



This is intended to be a long term position with consistent work as our company grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following questions. Specific examples are required. Generic applications will not be considered.



1. PERMITTING EXPERIENCE: Describe your experience preparing and submitting residential construction permits in the United States. How many years have you been doing this?



2. ACTUAL PERMIT PACKAGES: Tell us about three specific permit applications you have personally prepared and submitted. For each, include the city, county, state, type of construction, documents required, and your role in obtaining approval.



3. STATE EXPERIENCE: Have you prepared and submitted permits in North Carolina, Alabama, or Georgia? Identify the specific cities or counties and the types of permits you've handled.



4. CONFIDENCE LEVEL: Rate your confidence from 1 to 10 in independently managing residential construction permits in each state.



North Carolina:

Alabama:

Georgia:



Briefly explain each rating.



5. YOUR PROCESS: If we provide you with a residential project address, scope of work, and completed construction plans, walk us through how you would determine the requirements, prepare the permit packet, submit it, and obtain approval.



6. INSPECTIONS: Have you coordinated building inspections in the United States? Explain your experience.



7. WORK SAMPLES: Please provide a redacted example of a permit application package you personally prepared, if available. Remove all homeowner and confidential information.



8. AVAILABILITY: What hours can you work, when can you start, and what is your expected monthly salary in USD?



We are looking for someone experienced, resourceful, organized, and capable of taking complete ownership of this responsibility.

title: Sales Growth Manager
description:
Snaptique creates photo booth experiences for weddings, corporate events and brand activations. We’re looking for an experienced sales professional who can win business, strengthen our team and help build the systems that support our next stage of growth.



This is a hands-on role. You’ll personally pursue opportunities and help close deals while improving how our team sells, explains our products and hands booked events over to our coordination and operations teams.



The Role

We expect approximately 70% of your time to focus on selling and relationship development and 30% on coaching, training and process improvement. That balance will shift with business needs.



Sell and develop business:

-Build relationships with event planners, agencies, corporate buyers and event coordinators.

-Identify and pursue larger corporate opportunities.

-Lead discovery conversations, presentations and pitches.

-Help salespeople move difficult opportunities toward a decision.

-Grow repeat business and identify relevant opportunities to expand client bookings.

-Deliver profitable sales within approved pricing and operational capabilities.



Strengthen the team:

-Coach our corporate and wedding salespeople using real conversations, quotes and opportunities.

-Create practical training decks, product guides and sales resources.

-Make our packages, capabilities and client experience easier to understand and explain.

-Develop consistent approaches to discovery, recommendations, follow-up, objections and closing.

-Train our client coordinators to recommend appropriate upgrades after booking.



Improve how sales works:

-Establish clear lead ownership, follow-up expectations and accountability.

-Use daily sales reporting to prioritize selling, coaching and corrective action.

-Improve handoffs so coordination and operations receive complete, accurate information.

-Work with leadership to identify gaps and recommend future staffing needs.

-Help shape requirements for our developing lead-tracking agent, which will reconcile source inquiries with CRM bookings and flag missing leads or follow-up gaps.



What you bring:

-A track record of personally winning business through consultative selling.

-Experience coaching salespeople and improving team performance.

-Confidence selling customized services and managing opportunities with multiple decision-makers.

-The ability to turn product knowledge into clear client conversations and useful training.

-Practical experience building sales processes that people consistently follow.

-Sound commercial judgment and respect for the teams delivering what you sell.



Experience in events, experiential marketing, hospitality, agencies or related services would be valuable.

You’ll learn Snaptique’s products and business from our leadership team. You should arrive with the selling, coaching and process-building skills to contribute quickly.



What success looks like:

-More profitable bookings and a stronger pipeline.

-A team that sells with greater confidence and consistency.

-Clear product information and practical training materials.

-Reliable follow-up and fewer missed opportunities.

-Complete sales handoffs that reduce problems for coordination and operations.

-Less dependence on the CEO for routine sales management.



How to apply

Please send your résumé or professional profile, along with a short introduction covering:

-A significant sale you personally won and your role in winning it.

An example of how you improved a sales team or built a sales process, including results.

-What you would want to understand about Snaptique before proposing your first 90-day plan.

-Your preferred engagement structure, availability and compensation expectations.



We’re open to shaping the engagement around the right person. Tell us what you could build, what you could sell and how you would measure your contribution.

title: Full-Time Appointment Setter & Customer Service Representative — Roofing Company
description:
Chase Roofing & Masonry is looking for a hands-on appointment setter and customer service representative for a long-term role.



We need someone who takes responsibility for the phones and stays on top of our leads. We already have leads coming in through Angi,
, and other sources. We are not hiring you to generate or sell us leads. We need you to call them, follow up, answer incoming calls, and book appointments.



There will be busy periods, missed calls to return, and plenty of opportunities for new work. We need someone dependable who keeps things moving without waiting to be reminded.



PAY AND HOURS

- $1,000 USD per month.

- 50 hours per week.

- Evening and weekend availability required in U.S. Central Time (America/Chicago).

- Exact workdays, shift times, and breaks will be agreed before hiring.

- You will support our existing daytime secretary.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Take ownership of incoming calls, missed calls, and lead follow-ups during your shift.

- Call new leads promptly and return missed calls.

- Stay active with follow-ups throughout the shift. We expect the lead and callback queue to be reviewed every 60–90 minutes, with repeat calls made according to our agreed follow-up schedule and the customer’s availability.

- Speak with homeowners, understand what work they need, and book roofing and masonry estimates.

- Confirm appointments and keep customers updated.

- Keep accurate notes, appointments, and lead statuses in GoHighLevel.

- Transfer important calls to the right team member and send clear text updates when needed.

- Do not promise prices, insurance approvals, or start dates without authorization.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Someone hands-on, reliable, organized, and comfortable handling a busy phone workload.

- Clear, understandable spoken English. An accent or occasional grammar mistake is fine as long as customers can understand you and you can understand them.

- Phone customer service, appointment-setting, or sales experience preferred.

- GoHighLevel experience is a plus.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a good headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Someone interested in building a long-term working relationship.

We are willing to teach you our business and procedures. We are also open to learning from your experience and improving how we work together. We need someone willing to learn, communicate, and take responsibility.



TO APPLY

Send your resume, your availability in U.S. Central Time, and a short voice recording introducing yourself. Tell us about your phone experience, any GoHighLevel experience, and how you would handle a new lead while other calls and follow-ups are waiting.

title: Part-Time YouTube VA — Channel Management & Optimization
description:
Hiring: Part-Time YouTube Virtual Assistant — Channel Management & Optimization



We’re looking for an experienced YouTube Virtual Assistant to manage the daily operations of our educational and finance channels. This is an ongoing remote position working directly with our team.



Our ideal candidate is responsive, organized, reliable, efficient, and a fast learner. You should communicate promptly, meet deadlines consistently, keep tasks and files organized, and learn new tools and processes quickly.



You must have hands-on experience with YouTube management tools and video optimization and be comfortable handling a wide range of tasks with minimal supervision.



Weekly Workload



- One 8–10-minute YouTube video and three related Shorts per channel.

- Work alongside our video editor and other team members to coordinate production, prepare uploads, and manage channel operations.

- f you are looking for additional hours, there may be an opportunity to manage two YouTube channels**, depending on performance and availability.

- Help prepare and refine outlines, scripts, and calls to action.

- Coordinate with team members, maintain the content calendar, and track deadlines.

- Create or coordinate thumbnails and make basic edits when needed.

- Schedule approved content and verify that uploads publish correctly.

You should take initiative, ask questions when instructions are unclear, and keep us updated without repeated reminders. Please provide realistic time estimates and obtain approval before exceeding the agreed hours.



All content and significant channel changes must be approved before publishing or implementation.

title: WordPress Developer | Divi & Elementor Expert | Part-Time, As Needed
description:
We are looking for an experienced, reliable WordPress developer to assist with ongoing website maintenance, updates, troubleshooting, and occasional new page development across multiple websites.



THIS IS NOT A FULL-TIME POSITION. Work will be assigned on an as-needed basis, ranging from quick updates and minor fixes to occasional larger projects.



We are specifically looking for someone who is highly experienced with DIVI AND ELEMENTOR and understands how to build and maintain websites using their native visual builders, modules, and theme functionality.



WE DO NOT WANT WEBSITES BUILT ENTIRELY WITH CUSTOM CODE when the same functionality can be achieved through Divi or Elementor. Our team must be able to easily access, edit, and maintain website content without needing a developer for every small change.



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Maintain and update multiple WordPress websites.

- Build and modify pages using Divi Builder and Elementor.

- Troubleshoot WordPress errors, plugin conflicts, layout issues, and visual builder loading problems.

- Make small website updates, including text, images, links, menus, and formatting.

- Create new pages using existing designs and templates.

- Ensure websites are responsive and display correctly across desktop and mobile devices.

- Improve website performance and resolve technical issues as needed.

- Use existing theme functionality and plugins whenever practical rather than unnecessary custom coding.

- Ensure all completed work remains easily editable through the WordPress dashboard.

- Communicate clearly regarding task status, estimated completion times, and any issues encountered.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- STRONG EXPERIENCE WITH WORDPRESS, DIVI, AND ELEMENTOR IS REQUIRED.

- Excellent understanding of the Divi Visual Builder and Elementor page editor.

- Ability to troubleshoot WordPress issues independently.

- Experience with WordPress hosting, cPanel, plugins, and website backups.

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript for situations where custom code is genuinely necessary.

- Ability to work within existing websites without unnecessarily rebuilding pages or changing established designs.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

- Good written English and responsive communication.

- Ability to complete small tasks efficiently and accurately.



IMPORTANT: TIME TRACKING & BILLING EXPECTATIONS



We place a high priority on HONEST, ACCURATE, AND TRANSPARENT HOURLY BILLING.



Because this position involves frequent small tasks, we need a developer who is comfortable tracking and billing only for the actual time spent working. THIS IS NOT A FULL-TIME, 12-HOUR-A-DAY ROLE.



Our expectations include:



- ACCURATE TIME TRACKING: All hours billed must reflect actual time worked on assigned tasks.

- NO MINIMUM-HOUR BILLING: A task that takes 15 minutes should be billed for 15 minutes, not rounded up to an hour.

- ITEMIZED TIME REPORTING: Invoices must clearly identify the tasks completed and the time spent on each.

- EFFICIENCY: We expect an experienced developer to complete routine WordPress updates and fixes in a reasonable amount of time.

- PRIOR APPROVAL: Larger tasks or work requiring significant additional time must be discussed and approved before proceeding.

- NO GUARANTEED HOURS: Work is assigned only when needed. There may be periods with multiple tasks and others with little or no work.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship built on trust, efficiency, and billing transparency. ACCURATE TIME REPORTING IS A NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENT.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



Our ideal developer is experienced enough to quickly identify and resolve WordPress issues without spending unnecessary hours troubleshooting basic problems.



You should be comfortable handling a 10-minute website update just as professionally as a larger development project.



We value developers who communicate proactively, respect our time and budget, and understand the importance of keeping websites manageable for nontechnical team members.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A brief overview of your WordPress development experience, specifically with Divi and Elementor.

2. Links to 2–3 WordPress websites you have built or maintained using Divi or Elementor.

3. Your hourly rate in USD.

4. Confirmation that you are available for occasional, as-needed work without guaranteed weekly hours.

5. Confirmation that you agree to accurate, task-based time tracking and billing without minimum-hour charges.

6. A brief explanation of how you typically track and report your working hours.



A VIDEO INTERVIEW MAY BE REQUIRED BEFORE HIRING.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To confirm that you have read the entire posting, please include the exact phrase "Editable WordPress" in the subject line of your application.



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT INCLUDE THIS PHRASE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

title: Social Media Content Manager & Video Editor
description:
Part-Time | Starting at 5-10 Hours/Week | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



I am looking for a creative, proactive Social Media Content Manager & Video Editor to help manage and grow two very different social media accounts: a monetized personal
 profile and a custom apparel/embroidery business.



This position will begin with a 30-day paid trial at approximately 5 hours per week. The workload during the trial will be intentionally limited while we determine if we are a good fit.



If the trial goes well, I fully expect the number of hours per week to increase, along with the level of responsibility. I am looking for someone who can potentially become a long-term part of my businesses, not someone for a short-term project.



Starting pay: $6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and skill pay could be more or less



This Is NOT a Basic VA Position



I am not looking for someone who needs me to provide a detailed task list every day.



I need someone who can look at the content and data, think independently and tell me:



What is working



What isn't working



What we should do more of



What we should stop doing



What content opportunities I may be missing



What we should test next



If you see something in the analytics that I don't see, I want you to tell me.



Strong
/Meta analytics and dashboard experience is very important for this position.



ACCOUNT #1: Monetized Personal
 Profile



My personal
 profile is already monetized and growing.



The content is personality-driven and includes family/life, humor, parenting, business ownership, golf, stories and everyday experiences.



I will remain involved in the creative direction and final voice of this account because the content needs to authentically sound like me.



I will provide raw video, photos, stories and ideas.



You will help:



Turn raw video into engaging short-form Reels



Find the strongest moments within longer videos



Create strong hooks



Edit for pacing and viewer retention



Add captions and on-screen text



Repurpose existing content when appropriate



Help identify content opportunities from the material I provide



Review
 Professional Dashboard 



Track views, reach, engagement, retention/watch time, distribution, follower growth and monetization performance



Identify patterns between high- and low-performing content



Recommend new content or strategies based on actual performance



I don't need generic advice such as "post consistently."



I want someone who can look at the actual dashboard and say, "This is interesting. Here's what happened, here's what I think it means, and here's what I think we should try next."



ACCOUNT #2: Custom Apparel & Embroidery Business



I want to be considerably more hands-off with this account.



I own a custom apparel/embroidery business and regularly have photos and video of products, embroidery, behind-the-scenes work, customer orders and other content.



I want to be able to provide you with a large amount of raw video and photos and have you determine how to turn that material into good social media content.



Responsibilities may include:



Creating and editing Reels



Creating photo/product posts



Writing captions and hooks



Selecting the best footage and photos to use



Repurposing content



Planning content



Scheduling/publishing approved content



Creating content around products, promotions and seasonal opportunities



Reviewing account performance



Recommending what we should create next



The long-term goal is for me to be able to upload raw photos/video and trust you to turn them into a consistent, effective social media presence without needing daily direction from me.



Skills I'm Looking For



Strong experience with:



 and Meta social media management



 Professional Dashboard and/or Meta Business Suite



Short-form video editing



Reels



Hooks and viewer retention



Organic social media growth



Social media analytics



Content planning



Canva or similar design tools



CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut or similar video-editing software



 experience is particularly important.



This is not primarily an Instagram-aesthetic position. I want someone who understands
 content, audience behavior, distribution and analytics.



The Most Important Thing: Be Proactive



I value someone who takes initiative.



If a certain style of Reel is outperforming everything else, tell me.



If viewers are dropping off at the beginning of our videos, tell me.



If something I think is a good idea isn't working, tell me.



If you see an opportunity I haven't noticed, bring it to me.



I want someone comfortable giving recommendations and respectfully disagreeing with me when the data supports it.



I am looking for a combination of:



Video Editor + Content Creator + Social Media Manager + Analytical Thinker



You do not need to know everything on day one. I care about creativity, curiosity, reliability and your ability to learn and think independently.



Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



The position will begin with a 30-day paid trial at approximately 5 hours per week.



I do NOT expect the entire scope described above to be completed in five hours every week during the trial. We will prioritize the most important work while learning how well we work together.



If the 30-day trial is successful, I expect to increase the weekly hours.



There is significant opportunity for this role to grow as you take more responsibility for content creation and management.



I would much rather find one excellent person, build a long-term working relationship and increase their responsibilities over time than continually hire different freelancers.

title: Image Ad Creator | Ecommerce Static Ads and Swipe Research
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are an ecommerce company selling health, beauty, wellness and personal care products across international markets.



We are hiring an Image Ad Creator who can handle both competitor swipe research and static ad production for
 and Instagram.



You should be comfortable finding relevant ads, breaking down their hooks and visual concepts, and explaining why an idea is worth testing. You will then turn that research and approved creative briefs into original image ads.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist, revise your work based on feedback and testing results, and keep your references and final files organized.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Search the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources for relevant competitor ads.

• Study the audience problem, hook, angle, offer, visual structure and product presentation behind each reference.

• Compare research signals such as active status, run duration, repeated variations, available reach or impressions, market relevance and product fit.

• Record the source link, what makes the idea worth testing, and how you would adapt it for our product.

• Create original static ads from approved swipes and briefs, including product benefit, comparison, testimonial and offer concepts where appropriate.

• Develop variations by changing the hook, layout, imagery, copy treatment or angle while preserving the intended message.

• Use AI tools where helpful, then manually correct inaccurate product details, labels, text, hands, faces, lighting and other visible errors.

• Check the correct product, market, offer, copy, image dimensions and file quality before submitting.

• Deliver creatives within the agreed deadlines and complete revisions based on strategist and media buying feedback.

• Keep swipe references, working files and final exports easy for the team to find.

• Ask for clarification when a brief, claim or visual direction is unclear or potentially misleading.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Relevant experience producing static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping or DTC brands.

• Practical experience researching competitor swipes, supported by examples of your work.

• The ability to explain a creative concept beyond saying that it looks good or has high reach.

• An understanding that active status, reach, engagement and run duration are research signals, not proof of sales or profitability.

• Strong layout, typography, visual hierarchy, readability and product presentation skills.

• Proficiency in Canva. Photoshop or Figma experience is a plus.

• Practical AI image generation or editing experience is preferred.

• Careful attention to product packaging, spelling, copy, brief requirements and final exports.

• Clear communication, reliable delivery and a professional approach to feedback.

• Full time, long term availability, including weekends when required.



Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements or personal care advertising is preferred.



CREATIVE ACCURACY AND COMPLIANCE



You must recognize and flag potentially risky claims or visuals, including unsupported medical claims, guaranteed results, unrealistic timelines, misleading before and after images, aggressive personal attribute language, unsupported authority claims and celebrity or television personality lookalikes.



If a reference or brief raises a concern, clarify it with the Creative Strategist before proceeding. Do not assume that a competitor ad is suitable for us simply because it is active.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with SWIPE and answer all 12 questions below. Use specific examples from your existing work wherever possible.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping or DTC brands? What did you personally handle?

2. Which products, niches and markets have you worked with? Include any health, beauty, wellness or personal care experience.

3. Walk us through your swipe research process, from understanding the product to selecting useful competitor references. What do you search for, and how do you organize your findings?

4. How do you d
 whether a swipe is worth testing? If two ads have different reach figures, what else would you compare? Explain what the available signals can and cannot tell you.

5. From your existing work, share one competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Include both links, explain what you kept and changed, and share a verified result only if you have access to the supporting data.

6. How do you identify the core hook or angle of a swipe and adapt it without directly copying the competitor?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use, and what do you use each one for?

8. Describe one ad you created using AI. What did you generate, what did you correct manually, and how did you check the product details and final output?

9. How many quality static ad variations can you realistically complete in a normal working day, including research, editing and quality checks?

10. What claims or visuals in a health or beauty brief would make you pause and ask the strategist for clarification?

11. Share your CV and portfolio. Prioritize ecommerce static ads, swipe references and original adaptations. Make sure the links can be viewed without requesting access.

12. State your availability, weekend availability, earliest possible start date and expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that do not follow the instructions, answer the questions or provide relevant work samples will not move forward.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a combined image ad and swipe research test task after the initial screening.

title: Creative Strategist: Ecommerce Meta Ads, Swipes and Winning Angles
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international stores.



We are looking for experienced Creative Strategists who can research strong swipes, develop original angles, write direct-response copy, and guide Image Ad Creators in producing effective static ads.



You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, creative research, advertorial funnels, and how to turn market insights into concepts that can be tested and scaled. Practical experience with direct-response dropshipping creatives is important.



You will work with Image Ad Creators and the media-buying team to turn research and performance feedback into clear briefs, new concepts, and iterations of proven winners.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads, product pages, advertorials, customer reviews, pain points, objections, and market trends.

- Find promising swipes through the Meta Ad Library and other reliable research sources.

- Evaluate swipes using available reach, impressions, run duration, repeated variations, market relevance, and advertiser credibility.

- Break down the hook, angle, offer, structure, customer desire, and visual approach behind each reference.

- Turn product research and swipe insights into original concepts, direct-response copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Provide clear source links, copy, visual direction, target audience, offer, and deliverables in each brief.

- Guide Image Ad Creators and ensure their work follows the intended strategy and brief.

- Develop new concepts and test different customer problems, awareness levels, hooks, and angles.

- Create iterations of proven winners while preserving the reason the original creative worked.

- Review campaign performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next tests.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products, stores, and markets.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, bottlenecks, and next actions clearly.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research, direct-response, and customer-research skills.

- Ability to explain why an ad may be performing and turn that insight into an original concept.

- Ability to distinguish available performance evidence from assumptions. Ad longevity or engagement alone does not prove profitability.

- Strong understanding of hooks, angles, offers, customer awareness, and advertorial funnels.

- Experience writing ad copy and giving clear, actionable instructions to designers.

- Ability to use campaign data when recommending what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale.

- Familiarity with Meta compliance risks involving health and beauty products.

- Clear written and spoken communication for briefs, feedback, and team discussions.

- Ability to manage deadlines and maintain a steady creative-testing pipeline.

- Full-time availability and interest in long-term work.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements, or personal-care products.

- Experience with UK, EU, Canada, Israel, Switzerland, or US markets.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages, or offer pages.

- Experience leading designers or a small creative team.

- Experience working directly with media buyers.

- A portfolio containing ads, angles, or landing pages that achieved measurable results.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ANGLE and answer every question below.



1. How many years have you worked as a Creative Strategist for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Which products, niches, brands, and markets have you worked with?

3. Walk us through your complete swipe-research process.

4. What performance signals do you use to d
 whether a swipe is worth studying? Explain how you use reach, run duration, repeated variations, and other available evidence.

5. Share one winning angle you developed. Explain the research, insight, execution, and result. Include links and verified performance evidence where available.

6. How do you turn a competitor swipe into an original concept instead of copying it?

7. Have you written ad copy, advertorials, or landing pages? Please share examples.

8. How do you use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale?

9. What Meta compliance risks do you watch for in health and beauty advertising?

10. Have you led designers or Image Ad Creators? Describe your briefing and feedback process.

11. Share your CV, portfolio, sample briefs, swipe boards, landing pages, and any redacted performance evidence. Make sure all links are viewable.

12. State your availability, earliest start date, and any existing work commitments.

13. State your expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that do not follow the instructions or provide the requested answers and relevant work samples will not move forward.



Qualified applicants will receive a Creative Strategist assessment. Applicants who pass the assessment will be invited to an initial interview.

title: Image Ad Creator with Winning Swipe Research Experience
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-growing health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international markets.



We are looking for an experienced Image Ad Creator who can produce high-quality static ads and find strong competitor swipes. This is not a general graphic-design position. You must understand direct-response advertising and be able to explain why an ad concept is worth testing.



Your main responsibility will be creating static image ads for
 and Instagram. Strong swipe-research experience is highly preferred because we want someone who can identify promising concepts and turn them into original ad variations, rather than waiting for every idea to be provided.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist and receive feedback based on creative testing, media-buying results, and Meta compliance.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create static image ads for ecommerce products across health, beauty, wellness, and personal-care categories.

- Research competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, layouts, audience problems, and visual concepts.

- Evaluate swipes using available evidence such as reach, run duration, repeated concepts, active creative volume, market relevance, and product fit.

- Turn approved swipes and creative briefs into original ads without directly copying competitors.

- Create variations using different hooks, angles, offers, layouts, and visual approaches.

- Produce advertorial, testimonial, product-benefit, comparison, offer, and problem-solution ads.

- Use AI tools when appropriate to create or improve product scenes, backgrounds, models, and other creative elements.

- Correct AI-generated problems involving hands, faces, text, labels, lighting, shadows, and product accuracy.

- Follow every brief carefully and confirm the correct product, market, offer, copy, and claims before submission.

- Organize source links, swipe references, working files, and final creatives clearly.

- Revise ads based on strategist feedback, performance results, and rejected-ad learnings.

- Flag risky health claims, misleading visuals, or unclear instructions before proceeding.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience creating static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands.

- A portfolio containing relevant ecommerce image ads.

- Strong direct-response design skills, including visual hierarchy, typography, readability, layout, and product presentation.

- Experience using the Meta Ad Library and researching competitor ads.

- Ability to explain why a swipe may be working based on evidence, not only appearance.

- Ability to preserve the core idea behind a swipe while creating an original ad.

- Proficiency in Canva and Photoshop. Figma experience is a plus.

- Practical experience with AI image-generation or editing tools is preferred.

- Strong attention to product names, labels, offers, markets, claims, and brief requirements.

- Reliable communication and the ability to complete revisions professionally.

- Full-time, long-term availability.

- Weekend availability when required.



META COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must recognize and avoid risky elements such as:



- Cure, treatment, or medical claims.

- Guaranteed results.

- Unrealistic timelines.

- Misleading before-and-after concepts.

- Aggressive personal-attribute language.

- Unsupported authority or doctor claims.

- Celebrity or television-personality lookalikes.

- Offers or discounts that do not match the approved brief.



If a brief or swipe contains a risky claim or visual, stop and ask the Creative Strategist for clarification before creating or submitting the ad.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SWIPE.



Answer all questions below. General applications that do not answer the questions will not be prioritized.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands?

2. Which health, beauty, wellness, supplement, or personal-care products have you worked on?

4. What evidence do you use to d
 whether a swipe or concept is worth testing?

5. Share one example of a competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Explain what you changed.

6. How do you preserve the main reason a swipe works without copying the competitor directly?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use?

8. Describe one ad where you used AI. Explain what you generated and what you corrected manually.

9. How many high-quality static-ad variations can you normally produce per day?

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Our Instagram Has Been Dead for a Year. We're Hiring the Person Who Brings It Back — and We're Judging on Money, Not Likes.                                                                                                                                                                                                               Here's the hook: if "posting to post" is your thing, close this tab. We need someone who turns content into conversations our appointment setters can book, and our salespeople can close. That's the whole job.



Quick filter, silly on purpose: Does pineapple belong on pizza? One line in your application. No answer means you didn't read this.



Why this seat carries weight: long before a setter gets a reply or a closer gets a call, the prospect has already formed an opinion of us from what they found online. Everything you publish is the first impression, the credibility check, and often the d
 factor in whether a deal gets a chance to happen at all. If the content is weak, the pipeline behind it never gets tested. That's the leverage in this role — and it's why we're hiring carefully rather than quickly.



There's a second job underneath that one: earning attention from people who owe us nothing. Every day, a business owner's feed is packed with competitors, personalities, and brands all fighting for the same eyeballs. We want posts that get picked up and pushed out by the platform on their own merit, pull strangers onto our pages because the content was worth following for, and turn casual viewers into people who recognize us before a single message is sent. That doesn't happen by a
 and it doesn't happen with filler. It happens when someone has spent years learning exactly how the platforms reward content — and knows that a scroll decision gets made in a couple of seconds, with nothing but a thumbnail and an opening beat to earn it.



What the job actually is

Two channels, two businesses. You'll run social for a wellness brand and an AI brand — separate audiences, separate voices, separate strategies. They don't get to look alike or sound alike.



Own the channel strategy. Every platform we're on, why we're on it, what it's for, and how it connects to revenue. You build the plan and defend it with reasoning, not trends.



Earn attention first. Your openings have to win the scroll in the first couple of seconds, every time, because that's all the room there is in a crowded feed. No slow builds, no burying the point.



Run the calendar. Concept, brief, produce, publish, schedule, and keep the pipeline of content full without being chased.



Make the content. Short-form video, UGC-style pieces, graphics, carousels, copy, captions, hooks — you can produce across formats, not just one lane.



Build the
 assets. Our appointment setters run outreach by
, and they need visuals to go with it — images, graphics, and supporting assets. You produce those. You're not writing their sequences or sending their campaigns; you're making sure they always have something good to send.



Keep it all in GoHighLevel. Everything you produce gets organized inside GHL's content library so a setter mid-outreach can find the right asset in seconds instead of messaging you and waiting. That's a big part of why GHL fluency matters in this role.



Rebuild and grow the audience we actually want. A following made of the businesses and decision-makers we serve. Not random accounts with no reason to buy.



Own community and DMs. Respond, engage, start conversations, and hand warm interest to the setters with context so nothing sits cold.



Make our profiles convert. Bio, highlights, pinned posts, link paths — when a prospect checks us out before a call, the page should sell us for you.



Track and report inside GoHighLevel. Reach, engagement, profile visits, inbound conversations, lead sources, leads handed off. You know which numbers matter and which are decoration, and you can show attribution in GHL instead of guessing.



Work with the sales side. You sit with our setters and closers on messaging, objections, and what's converting — and you adjust content based on what they hear on calls.



Communicate in Slack, all day. Slack is where our team runs. Updates, questions, wins, blockers, and anything the team needs to know live there — not in scattered
s or side threads.



Post a real end-of-day report in Slack. What you published, what you produced, what's performing, goals hit, what's next, and where you need the team's input.



Test and kill. Try things, measure them, keep what works, cut what doesn't, and tell us why.



Bring the playbook. The thinking behind how Gary Vee, Alex Hormozi, and Russell Brunson turned attention into revenue — hook psychology, offer clarity, funnel thinking, volume — applied to us instead of quoted at us.



You'll also work across YouTube and Skool as part of that mix, and you'll be producing UGC-style content with tools like Higgsfield, Canva, and CapCut, with AI built into how you work.



Read this before you apply

Plenty of applicants never read the post. Plenty more are agencies trying to place someone into the role. We hire individuals only — no VA companies, no agency placements.



What we need from you

5+ years in social media marketing.



3+ years as an active GoHighLevel user. You've actually worked in GHL — content library, pipelines, lead tracking, attribution — not just heard of it.



A portfolio we can verify that's still live today. Active accounts, working links, real engagement. Dormant profiles and dead sites don't count as proof.



A provable track record of growth and revenue, not just audience size. A marketing degree is a plus; results matter more.



Fluency in UGC production and the tools behind it — Higgsfield, Canva, CapCut — plus comfort with AI in your workflow.



Strong written English, self-direction, and high-speed internet with a backup.



Slack proficiency, since that's where the team operates.



A revenue-generator's mindset. You think like someone who owns a number, because you'll be measured like one. You will also receive a bonus on revenue/sales that came from your social media content. 



Tools

You'll have what you need to do the job from day one. Higgsfield, Canva, CapCut, and the AI tools in your workflow are provided by us — we expect proficiency because you'll be using them starting your first week. If you already have your own stack you're excellent with and would rather keep working in it, that's your call, and we're fine with it. What we care about is output, not subscriptions. And as the channels grow, we'll keep investing in whatever helps you take them further.



What you submit

Your resume.



Live links to accounts you've worked on. Active, verifiable, with engagement worth showing. Broken links end the application.



Results — growth and revenue those accounts produced, how you tracked it, and where GHL fit into that tracking.



Your answer to the pineapple question.



If you're here to make pretty posts, we'll pass. If you can build channels that put qualified buyers in front of our sales team, we want to see your work.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels / TikTok / YouTube Shorts | Ongoing Work
description:
## Short-Form Video Editor — Reels / TikTok / YouTube Shorts



Journey of Returning (JOR) is a Miami-based marketing and customer acquisition consultancy managing content for multiple professional-service brands.



We are looking for a talented, reliable **short-form video editor** for ongoing client work across Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.



Our clients include law firms, founders, professional-service companies, and organizations where the content needs to feel polished, credible, modern, and engaging.



This is **not** a role for someone who believes good short-form editing means adding as many transitions, emojis, effects, or animations as possible.



We are looking for strong **editorial judgment, pacing, taste, retention thinking, and attention to detail.**



### WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



Most projects will include:



- founder / attorney talking-head videos

- educational short-form content

- commentary and opinion videos

- rapid-response content

- rankings and tier-list style videos

- interview-style clips

- occasional event or behind-the-scenes content

- Reels, TikToks,
 videos, LinkedIn video, and YouTube Shorts



Footage, brand assets, messaging direction, and creative briefs will generally be provided.



### WHAT A GREAT EDIT SHOULD DO



Every video should feel intentionally edited for short-form consumption.



That includes:



**Strong opening seconds**

- Make the first 1–3 seconds visually compelling

- Highlight the verbal hook when appropriate

- Remove unnecessary pauses or slow openings



**Excellent pacing**

- Tighten dialogue naturally

- Remove dead space

- Maintain momentum without making the speaker feel unnatural

- Understand when a cut, punch-in, B-roll shot, graphic, or pause improves retention



**Professional captions**

- Accurate spelling and punctuation

- Clean, branded typography

- Strategic emphasis of important words

- Easy to read on mobile

- No distracting caption overload



**Tasteful visual movement**

- Punch-ins / zooms when useful

- Reframing when appropriate

- B-roll when it strengthens the point

- Graphics or screenshots when relevant

- Motion graphics where they add value



**Sound**

- Clean dialogue

- Balanced audio

- Appropriate music when requested

- Subtle sound design when it improves the edit



**Brand consistency**

Each JOR client has a different identity. You must be able to follow individual brand guidelines instead of applying the same editing style to every client.



### IMPORTANT: WE DO NOT WANT OVER-EDITING



Many of our clients are attorneys, executives, founders, and professional organizations.



Their content still needs to compete for attention, but it cannot look cheap, gimmicky, or overly edited.



We generally prefer:



**editorial > flashy**



**clean > chaotic**



**intentional > trendy for the sake of being trendy**



**retention-focused > effect-focused**



The viewer should remember **what the person said**, not how many transitions the editor used.



---



## INITIAL PAID EDITING TEST — GKZ



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete the same **paid short-form editing test** using content from one of our law-firm clients, GKZ.



You will receive:



- raw video footage

- brand assets / visual direction

- editing instructions

- context for the video

- any necessary supporting materials



You will be asked to create one finished vertical short-form video.



The purpose is not to see who can add the most effects.



We will evaluate:



- opening hook treatment

- pacing

- storytelling

- caption design

- typography

- B-roll judgment

- visual hierarchy

- audio quality

- professionalism

- brand consistency

- retention instincts

- spelling / attention to detail

- ability to follow the creative brief



### PAID TRIAL RATE



**$15 USD for the trial edit.**



The same raw footage and brief will be provided to shortlisted candidates so we can evaluate everyone fairly.



---



## ONGOING COMPENSATION



Starting rate:



### **$15 USD per standard short-form video**



Standard videos generally include:



- editing supplied footage

- removing unnecessary pauses

- pacing / jump cuts

- captions

- basic sound treatment

- appropriate punch-ins

- basic B-roll / visual support when needed

- branded typography

- vertical formatting

- final export



Videos requiring substantially more complex editing, animation, motion graphics, extensive sourcing, or unusual production requirements may be priced separately before work begins.



There is potential for increased rates as the relationship grows and quality/reliability are demonstrated.



---



## ONGOING VOLUME



We manage multiple client accounts and are looking for someone who can become a consistent part of our production workflow.



Initial volume may be approximately:



### **15–25+ short-form videos per month**



Volume may increase as additional client work is assigned.



One current client alone produces approximately **16 short-form videos per month**.



We are interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right editor.



---



## TURNAROUND + WORKFLOW



You should be comfortable:



- working from organized batches of raw footage

- following creative briefs

- using client-specific brand assets

- meeting agreed deadlines

- submitting organized drafts

- handling reasonable revision requests

- incorporating feedback into future edits so the same correction is not repeatedly required



Reliability is extremely important.



We do not want to micromanage an editor indefinitely. The goal is to develop someone who understands each client's style and becomes increasingly autonomous.



---



## TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS



You should be comfortable producing:



- vertical 9:16 video

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok

- YouTube Shorts

-
 short-form

- LinkedIn-ready video when applicable



Experience with software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop, or equivalent professional editing tools is welcome.



We care more about the final work than which program you use.



---



## YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:



- specialize in short-form video

- understand social-media retention

- have excellent visual taste

- understand professional / premium branding

- know when NOT to add an effect

- have excellent written English

- catch spelling and caption errors

- are highly detail-oriented

- take feedback well

- communicate clearly

- meet deadlines consistently

- can work independently

- are interested in a long-term client relationship



Experience editing:



- attorneys

- professional services

- founders

- executives

- educational content

- personal brands



is a major plus.



---



## TO APPLY



Please send:



**1. Short-form portfolio**



Send **3–5 examples of your BEST short-form work**.



Please do not send 30 links.



We want to see your strongest work.



**2. Professional-services example**



If available, send at least one example involving an attorney, executive, founder, consultant, educator, or other talking-head professional.



**3. Editing software**



Tell us which editing software you primarily use.



**4. Turnaround**



Tell us your typical turnaround time for one standard 30–60 second short-form video.



**5. Current workload**



Tell us approximately how many short-form videos you can reliably edit per week.



**6. Pricing**



Confirm whether you are comfortable beginning at **$15 USD per standard video**.



**7. Paid test**



Confirm that you are willing to complete a **$15 paid editing test** if shortlisted.



### IMPORTANT



Please begin your application with:



**GKZ EDIT**



Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed.



We are looking for an editor who wants consistent work and can grow with Journey of Returning as our client roster and content production continue to expand.
