title: Inside Sales Representative / Sales Executive
description:
Who are we?



We are CoreVista Cleaning LLC a House Cleaning Company based out of metro Atlanta, GA, USA.



We coordinate cleaning jobs between our customers and our team of cleaners.



This company is growing fast and we are seeking our next A+ Team Member.



Why Should You Work Here?



This is a massive opportunity to start working for a company right before it gets HUGE.

Currently we are shattering every single company record with each new month.

This is an exciting place to work where not only do you get a fully remote position, but there is ample opportunity for growth and Career Advancement.



Starting Pay:



$$180 to 240 USD per week (Depending on Experience)

60 Hours per week (Monday - Friday EST)

10 hours per day

$3 to $4/Hour (Experience Based); Not Including Commissions



Who are we looking for?



We are looking for a high-energy, resilient, and results-driven Inside Sales Representative / Sales Executive to drive growth for our professional residential cleaning business. In this role, you will be the engine of our sales pipeline. You will be responsible for aggressively hunting for new business through outbound cold calling, while seamlessly converting incoming hot leads from our marketing channels (like Google LSA) into booked, long-term clients.



This position requires a vibrant, engaging personality and a high degree of autonomy. While you will receive regular support, feedback, and structured follow-ups from your supervisor, you must have the discipline to drive your daily numbers and work independently to hit your targets.



Key Responsibilities



• Outbound Pipeline Generation: Conduct a minimum of 100 outbound cold calls daily targeting real estate agencies, brokers,  construction companies and property management companies to secure residential cleaning contracts, move-out cleans, post construction cleanups and recurring turnover accounts.

• Inbound Closing & Conversion: Answer and close hot inbound lead calls. Bring a positive, warm, and professional personality to every interaction to build instant rapport with homeowners.

• Lead Nurturing & Follow-Up: Systematically follow up with prospects who previously requested residential cleaning quotes, ensuring no opportunity drops out of the funnel.

• Objection Handling & Scripts: Utilize and master company-provided scripts for inbound calls and objection handling. Turn "no's" into "yes's" by confidently overcoming hesitation regarding price, scheduling, or competitor comparisons.

• Independent Daily Management: Manage your daily call volume, lead callbacks, and pipeline efficiently with minimal hand-holding, while actively participating in scheduled performance check-ins with your supervisor.

• Smart Scheduling: Manage, update, and accurately book cleaning appointments directly into our scheduling platform, ScheduleDrop.



Requirements & Qualifications



• Sales Experience: Prior professional sales experience is required, with a proven track record of handling high-volume outbound calling and direct closing environments.

• Autonomous Work Ethic: Proven ability to work independently, stay self-motivated, and maintain high productivity without constant micro-management. Comfort responding positively to constructive supervisor follow-ups and performance coaching.

• Winning Personality: Outstanding interpersonal skills, an upbeat attitude, and a natural ability to connect with people over the phone.

• Advanced Objection Handling: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection, manage difficult sales conversations, and confidently navigate price negotiations.

• Tech-Savvy: Experience utilizing CRM or booking software. Prior hands-on experience with ScheduleDrop is highly preferred, though comprehensive training will be provided for the right candidate.

• Communication and Organizational Skills: Exceptional verbal communication, a professional phone presence, and the ability to strictly follow and adapt sales scripts with the ability to track work

• Stable internet connection and reliable laptop/PC is REQUIRED



What We Offer



• Competitive base salary plus an aggressive commission structure (uncapped earning potential).

• Comprehensive training program on our services, scripts, and the ScheduleDrop platform.

• Mentorship and structured supervisor check-ins designed to support your independent success.





How To Apply

Please message your resume via Onlinejobsph

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST: HEALTH, BEAUTY META ADS AND DIRECT RESPONSE
description:
WE OFFER COMPETITIVE SALARY TO QUALIFIED PEOPLE



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across several international stores.



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who can find strong swipes, develop original angles, write persuasive direct-response copy, and guide Image Ad Creators in producing effective static ads.



This is not a general social media, media-buying, or graphic-design role. You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, creative research, advertorial funnels, and how to turn market insights into concepts that can be tested and scaled.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads, product pages, advertorials, customer reviews, pain points, objections, and market trends.

- Find promising swipes through the Meta Ad Library and other reliable research sources.

- Evaluate swipes using reach, impressions, run duration, repeated variations, market relevance, and advertiser credibility.

- Break down the hook, angle, offer, structure, customer desire, and visual approach behind each reference.

- Turn research into original concepts, direct-response copy, offers, and detailed creative briefs.

- Guide Image Ad Creators and ensure their work follows the intended strategy and brief.

- Develop genuinely new concepts instead of repeatedly redesigning an existing angle.

- Create thoughtful iterations of proven winners while preserving the reason the original creative worked.

- Review campaign performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next tests.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products, stores, and markets.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, bottlenecks, and next actions clearly.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research, direct-response, and customer-research skills.

- Able to explain why an ad may be performing and turn that insight into an original concept.

- Strong understanding of hooks, angles, offers, customer awareness, and advertorial funnels.

- Comfortable writing ad copy and giving clear, actionable instructions to designers.

- Able to use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale.

- Familiar with Meta compliance risks involving health and beauty products.

- Comfortable managing deadlines and maintaining a steady creative-testing pipeline.

- Available full time and interested in long-term work.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements, or personal-care products.

- Experience with UK, EU, Canada, Israel, Switzerland, or US markets.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages, or offer pages.

- Experience leading designers or a small creative pod.

- Experience working directly with media buyers.

- A portfolio containing ads, angles, or landing pages that achieved measurable results.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word **STRATEGY**.



Answer every question below. General or incomplete answers may not be considered.



1. How many years have you worked as a Creative Strategist for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Which products, niches, brands, and markets have you worked with?

3. Walk us through your complete swipe-research process.

4. What performance signals do you use to d
 whether a swipe is worth studying?

5. Share one winning angle you developed. Explain the research, insight, execution, and result.

6. How do you turn a competitor swipe into an original concept instead of copying it?

7. Have you written ad copy, advertorials, or landing pages? Please share examples.

8. How do you use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale?

9. What Meta compliance risks do you watch for in health and beauty advertising?

10. Have you led designers or Image Ad Creators? Describe your briefing and feedback process.

11. Share your CV, portfolio, sample briefs, swipe boards, landing pages, and any redacted performance evidence.

12. State your availability or earliest start date.

13. State your expected monthly salary in USD.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a Creative Strategist assessment.
